**My opponent Josh Hawley, the guy who raised his fist then ran away on January 6th, really thinks he’s some kind of tough guy, Peter.**
He’s made a whole career out of trying to control other people. And he has the most extreme anti-freedom record on reproductive rights of any member of the U.S. Senate — on abortion, birth control, and even IVF.
He’s become obsessed with convincing all of us that he’s the authority on what it means to be a man. Last year, he published a whole book about it: _Manhood: The Masculine Virtues America Needs._ It’s all about how we should be made in his own creepy image.
**And he wants you to pay $30 to read it:**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/78124?refcode=em20241016-8099&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=6&akid=8099%2E614464%2E7eylaY)

**I’m fighting to put everyday people in charge of their own bodies, families, and lives.** In the Senate, I’ll end these attacks from control-obsessed politicians like Hawley by codifying Roe v. Wade, taking real action to protect critical reproductive healthcare like birth control and IVF, and standing up to anyone who gets in my way.
**[So Peter, will you chip in $10 or whatever you can to my grassroots campaign today? Counsel for the health department is accusing the ad of violating the “sanitary nuisance” law — often used to charge people with overflowing septic tanks or unclean slaughterhouses, which can carry a sentence of up to 60 days of imprisonment. If you haven’t guessed, the ad isn’t about septic tanks or slaughterhouses. It’s about a woman named Caroline. Caroline is a mother in Florida who was diagnosed with brain cancer during her second pregnancy. She had an abortion in order to receive treatment to fight that cancer and be there for her young daughter. That treatment would not have been allowed under Ron DeSantis’s abortion ban, and it would not be allowed under bans that my opponent Tony Wied would allow states to implement. Everyone knows why. | | |
---
|
---
Is Mitch McConnell secretly stabbing conservative senators in the back this November? That's the scoop, according to _The Hill: "**Cruz and Scott, both McConnell critics, get cold shoulder amid tough races."**_
---
|
---
---
|
---
Recent polls in Texas and Florida show incumbent Senators **Ted Cruz** and **Rick Scott** in neck-and-neck races against leftwing Democrat challengers with control of the Senate hanging in the balance. Yet, while McConnell’s money machine is pouring cash into some Senate races, it’s conspicuously ignoring these two key states. Everyone knows why. October 16, 2024
The Democratic Party is now the party of the rich and a dancing bear for Wall Street. And Exhibit A is their Bag Man Jim Himes, Democratic Congressman from Greenwich, Connecticut.
A former Goldman Sachs employee, Himes along with his other big money cronies at Goldman Sachs were bailed out by our grandchildren when their bets on certain financial instruments went south in 2008 and they were about to lose their Gold Coast beach homes in Fairfield County and the Hamptons.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5972e836-0525-4385-8359-0041de55315e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Former Goldman Sachs Employee Congressman Jim Himes
And at the risk of raising the reader's blood pressure level to dangerous levels, a brief recap is necessary.
In the early 2000's, banks goaded by the federal government lent money to anyone who wanted to buy a house, even if the purchaser had a small down payment and a low income. The banks who made these risky loans then sold the mortgages to investment banks such as Goldman Sachs who packaged these loans into bonds called Collateralized Mortgage Bonds and resold them to other financial institutions.
Goldman Sachs and these other institutions purchased a type of derivative (a financial product that enables you to make a large amount of money with small price changes in the underlying asset) called credit default swaps (CDS).
These CDS's were insurance against the bonds losing value and were sold by insurance companies such as AIG (American International Group). But then homeowners started defaulting on their mortgages and the value of the Collateralized Mortgage Bonds plummeted. But AIG who sold the CDS's didn't have enough cash to cover these losses.
Thus all these Wall Street Masters of the Universe were about to go broke. But Wall Street knows that the best investment possible is to fund the campaigns of politicians like Jim Himes. The manicured hands of these grifters reached for their phones and voila, the political class complied and passed TARP (Trouble Asset Relief Program) giving Wall Street a trillion dollars, giving our grandchildren the bill and allowing the wives of these grifters to update their fur collection.
If you are embarrassed because you cannot quite follow the above explanation, don't be. I don't quite understand it either and I wrote it.
But an oversimplified example is this: Let's say John borrows $10,000 from Harry and uses this money to play blackjack at the casino. If John wins, he gets to keep his winnings and pays Harry back his $10,000. But if he loses, he refuses to pay Harry back and Harry must get a job bagging groceries so he can afford to live. Now replace John with Goldman Sachs and Harry with you, the taxpayer. And Jim Himes's goal is to make you Harry in this example.
How is he doing this?
In 2013, he proposed [HB 992 ](https://substack.com/redirect/489cc445-d789-46d2-9eb9-77ef336c8765?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)to reverse the laws passed after the bail out to restrict derivative trading. He didn't even bother to write the bill. His contributors from Citibank did! Fortunately, the U.S. Senate refused to pass it.
When Silicon Valley Bank (SVC) was paying high interest rates on uninsured deposits over $250,000, Jim Himes supported Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen's (who received $7,000,000 in "speaking fees" from Wall Street) bailout of the billionaires when the green energy start-up scams SVC was financing couldn't repay their loans. Middle class depositors got the bill with higher banking fees.
The popular perception is that Fairfield County is populated by uber rich titans, and that Jim Himes is just doing his job in servicing them; but that isn't true. Fairfield County has huge wealth disparities. But as far as Himes is concerned, his job is to support his contributors, not his constituents.
And it's working. Jim Himes has over $2,000,000 in his war chest thanks to his Wall Street cronies while his courageous Republican opponent Dr. Mike Goldstein brags if he gets $100 out of one of his medical school buddies.
And Congressman Jim Himes is sitting of his fat portfolio and living in his posh Greenwich abode courtesy of the bail out of Goldman Sachs by our grandchildren.

Peter -
We’ve sent a number of emails your way about our final FEC deadline tonight, our pre-general election filing deadline. We’re not doing it to annoy you. We’re doing it because this is really, truly important to our chances.
We’re doing it because we are running out of time.
We’re losing time to hit our goals. We’re losing time to scare off additional outside spending. We’re losing time to reach critical undecided voters — as much as 5-10% of Arizona — before they return their ballots or vote early.
We’ve got to do well here because we’ve consistently polled ahead of the top of the ticket. If we bring more voters to Ruben, it’s all the more likely that we can turn voters against Trump, too. And **if Trump loses in Arizona, Nate Silver says we have a 93% chance at keeping him out of the White House.**
That matters. It’s not just about keeping Kari Lake out of the Senate here. It’s about stopping Trump for good, and Arizona is the key.

Support your fellow Americans suffering in the aftermath
of Hurricane Helene.
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/oWHrMHPWN7

Friend,

When Hurricane Helene devastated Western North Carolina, the
federal government's response left many families stranded and
desperate without much help.

Millions of dollars were sent overseas while Americans here at
home suffered. That's when Operation Helo stepped up, and the
American people-people like you-answered the call.

Volunteers from all across the country risked their safety to
help their fellow Americans in need. With your support, we've
been able to deliver life-saving aid to communities whose lives
have been shattered by this storm.

But even though the news cameras are gone and the storm has
passed, the devastation remains.

Entire towns are still struggling to rebuild. Families who have
lost everything are picking up the pieces, and Operation Helo
needs your help to continue providing critical support.

The work is far from over, and we are relying on the generosity
of people like you to make a difference.

Your donation will:

Provide housing assistance to displaced families

Help with funeral costs for those who tragically lost loved
ones

Support long-term recovery efforts for entire communities
still reeling from the storm

Every single dollar counts. When the government fell short, we
stepped in. Now, we're asking you to continue supporting our
mission to help families rebuild and recover

It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. ## Trump, Harris Both Take Campaign to Fox News
Former President Trump and Vice President Harris [appeared on Fox News on Wednesday](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00DFzhCAQBeBfAx037MqBFBRp7C5tSsfT9SRBcWDjJf8-Y7oUqb957828t1t_G2KK2-N1WCnwnPth5HhQD1qBU2h6I6cwEyE1kgI49GBNaxu5BOuu4EajafJgx2m-t7OxMLWtNWC9G2UMqNGABgdat4AX8o11HtG1Q3PV_i7OcORcLu85brzQnL7zQeUy5lWmsDDvVTQvAjuBHS-0xJROE9ht9KyJmKlUgR0dtMXtoQrtubDAzvjGGTDqLygun-uulqGUWFUl-lBHZqoqb2rOX-osFdjJEqb9GVOK1Tph9GMd4u-u5H8uOgL-BAAA___zZWmF), with Trump aiming to improve his support among female voters in a female-focused town hall and Harris seeking to appeal to moderate Republicans.Women in the audience described Trump’s appearance at the town hall as “warm,” “friendly,” and the opposite of the person portrayed in the media. [You can see their reactions here](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0z7FuwyAQgOGngS0Wd2AwA0MXb-na0SL2EV-FTWQj07591e6df-mXvo_7dI-ceX--x41CTWWKc-WLJlA3cDc0k5FLSERIWlIAhx6sGayWa0gWAFxUgJb6h3E0Dyr2aJIfZm3RSg6o0IACB0oNgB15bZ1HdEPUvfIPYRQtXMvRfRbe60opf5eLjm4um8xhrfV1Cv0mcBQ4tta6VL52audvFzhevFAROFpttTbgsQdAeYTl1ThnPq0TRj23yPlvWP_xXQF_AgAA__82807k).Harris participated in [a tense 30-minute interview](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx0kLGOszAQhJ_GdI52F2JD4eJv6PK3VyKDl2RPBiPsEOXtT0TXXjPNJ32ama_bcPMSZb3_9wu7MqfBT0UOHhA0Wk3N0FTBzczEdcUOLXVomtbU1cP5K5rZ12M7gbnCFOw0jtbPbUA0nixU4gioQUCLAC3Shbva2I7Itr6-QjeqBjhISfvlO8laHjzHdzp4v0xpqaJ7lLJlVf9T1Cvq1_eWcjmRov4UK-oRzjCK-mfWK7_yL9LbzlkCr0V81Bx5KpJWHeVg_dyCL5z1udDoj6baXdheEqNkY1UD98VL_JQof3xyOPoJAAD__4zzYCU) with host Bret Baier, who said afterward that she relied on prepared talking points, leading to frequent interruptions as he tried to steer the conversation in a different direction. During the interview, her first formal sit-down with the cable news channel, Baier and Harris sparred over her positions on immigration, sex-changing surgery for prisoners, and foreign policy.
## Navy Jet Crashes Near Mount Rainier
A U.S. Navy EA-18G [Growler aircraft crashed](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00LFu7CAQQNGvgc4rGPPAFBSvcbdpU1pje1gmYmGFkVf--yjpU1_pFufzvtyRM5fHBz4p9FgX3DqftGg1aDeAWYzcQyQCGiUF7cBrayY7yhS8ncyk1YrRuSkiKWu2ddfOrzusSCA5gAKjlXZaqUnDjfxonQdwE47_lF-FUbRzr-32Vbn0RDFf9aR22-pT5pB6fx1i_C9gFjD3RIlz_mkC5lfNvF0C5p0ilYMEzMaP1hg7FDyvAbltDWMftoZHGt54JC6PXouAWbawv96cMx_WCaMeT-Tfr-x_EJwBvgMAAP__WaxdnA) east of Mount Rainier, Washington, during a training flight on Tuesday afternoon, with two crew members onboard, the Navy said.The aircraft, based out of Naval Air Station Whidbey Island, went down around 3:20 p.m., and search efforts, including a Navy MH-60S helicopter, are underway to locate the crew.The cause of the crash is under investigation, and the crew's status remains unknown as of Wednesday.The Growler is part of Electronic Attack Squadron 130, which recently returned from a [nine-month deployment in the Middle East](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx00LGO4yAQgOGnwR0WM0MAFxQnndzlmtPpSovgcUxkmwhYR3n71W6_9d_8-v5fp2tIWzruf8LOvi15CrGlkydQEqxEPelu9gszMnXsweIARjtD3eoJnLOGYCZrlwgUl0CBQc8XYy5BUZc8KtSgwIJSDrDngYwdEK0LdFHDTWjFc2q59I-cjrbysr3zyaWPee82v7b2rIJ-CRwFjuEWD37V_p6_ssDx31-B4xHOt3xwk7GEunKVe_44miwhHYmLRBkLv-TO-41LFTjWlstb0JhmQb8BtNPoaOiKn5-vtG2pGiu0uu8hbd8X7QeU0-NnAAAA__9zkWId).

And what was his response? He laughed!! There's nothing funny about this, Peter. I was on the House floor on January 6 when rioters breached the Capitol. First, I heard the glass break. Then, as they pounded on the doors, I texted my wife Aly, who was seven months pregnant with our second son: "Whatever happens, I love you." I took off my jacket and got ready to fight anyone who came through the door. Thankfully, it never came to that. But while I was barricaded on the House floor with my colleagues with our gas masks in hand, Ted Cruz – who had cheered on the mob earlier that day – hid in a supply closet. In just 20 days, we have the chance to replace Ted Cruz and give Texans the Senator we deserve. But after this week’s debate, a fresh wave of GOP spending is pouring into Texas to crush our momentum in this final push. And the latest polling still shows this race locked neck and neck. [There's no doubt in my mind that we can win this race and finally hold Ted Cruz accountable – but ONLY if we have the resources to do it. So please, will you split a donation between me and Blue Amp Action now to fuel our grassroots movement to victory and defeat Ted Cruz once and for all? # Thursday, October 17, 2024
---|---
**Good morning!** On this day in 1902, [actress Irene Ryan](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0z72OqzAQQOGnsbugmYkxuHBxG6RbZItttkQ2HsJozY_ASsLbr7L9lqf5pPN1629Bsiz3jzCzL69x7VOQfPYEZC4IF2x6o5OPkBxq9tiQQ0utdXryw2A51HZ0BMa2bXRjDYwQTWB2sQUt_s0gYIMICHUVnRuotjbW13bAa1AGOElZ96pMXPgVjjGf64P3alhnnf1Uynao6z9FnaKOl-op37JxklCt-11R925F3f-dF-4_z7Do3aftKTnLYRtl4D4Hyb9a-XPv4eknAAD__2pyUdA) was born in El Paso. body:

Please see a special message from our sponsor:

Dear Fellow American,

American civics education, and specifically the teaching of American history, is at a crisis point.

In K-12 schools nationwide, false narratives are being constructed, and content is being cherry-picked to fit an ideological (and frankly anti-American) agenda. Maybe you've even seen this happening in your local
schools.

As a result, we are faced with a choice: will we allow our children to be indoctrinated using curricula developed by anti-American ideologues and promoted by Left-wing education bureaucrats?

Or will we insist that our children are taught honestly, using a curriculum that presents a fair, unbiased, and comprehensive view of our nation's history?

We must insist on the latter, both for the sake of truth and for the sake of our children and America's future.

For this reason, we have produced the Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum-and I'm writing to ask your help in promoting this curriculum to educators, homeschool families, and concerned citizens nationwide.

What is the Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum?

The Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum is a K-12 history and civics curriculum that covers the triumphs and tragedies of American history fairly and comprehensively.

This curriculum has been designed not by activists or ideologues but by teachers and professors at Hillsdale College-and we are making it available free of charge.

To be clear, the Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum is not a slap-dash response to the efforts of anti-American ideologues to indoctrinate our children.

It is a 2,000-page, 85-lesson curriculum based on decades of studying American history. Developed over 18 months of intense and focused effort, its roots extend as far back as the beginning of Hillsdale College in
1844.

And we need your help to make the Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum available to educators, homeschool families, and concerned citizens nationwide...and to make it available free of charge so that it will have the greatest
impact.

We have set a budget goal of $800,000 to promote the Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum and our other outreach efforts-including Imprimis, free online courses, and our classical K-12 charter school initiative.

That's an ambitious budget, and we need to get started as soon as possible.

One reason why your support really matters: Hillsdale College refuses to accept one penny in taxpayer support-not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. This makes our work uniquely
dependent on the support of citizens like you-citizens who agree with Hillsdale's mission on behalf of liberty.

We remind ourselves daily of Hillsdale's 180-year-old mission-to provide "sound learning" of the kind needed to preserve "the inestimable blessings of civil and religious liberty."

With that mission in mind, we produced the Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum-and now we need your help to promote it nationwide.

Will you take this opportunity to support the Hillsdale 1776 Curriculum and our other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty?

Understanding that a proper education is vital to the preservation of liberty-and that the anti-American indoctrination now being forced on too many American children poses an existential threat to liberty-I hope you
will make your most generous tax-deductible gift today.

I've included a secure link for your convenience here:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/ct/63635915:Wgp_WPWJN:m:3:2532013465:01FD8EECFEEDDC08E82AFD70E19272DA:r

Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to hearing from you.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

body:
FEC filings contradict Democrat Frisch’s claims that he doesn’t take corporate PAC money
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi everyone,
This is the Mountain Minute for Thursday, October 17, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[FEC filings contradict Democrat Frisch’s claims that he doesn’t take corporate PAC money](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_Adam Frisch, the Democratic nominee for Colorado’s 3rd Congressional District, has told his supporters in person, in debates, on social media and on national television, that he does not take corporate or PAC money._
_The claims just don’t track with his own campaign filings to the Federal Election Commission (FEC). Neither does the fact that he has more than $13 million dollars in his campaign account._
_According to FEC records, Frisch has received 528 corporate donations through political-action committees._
_Frisch’s PAC donors include ACTBLUE, BLUEHEN, Progressive Turnout Project, Democrats Reshaping America PAC, Progressive Choices PAC, Jeffries For Congress, and Beyond Thoughts And Prayers PAC, just to name a few._

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[RSVP FOR FREE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[Prop. 127’s ‘unintended consequences’ could be devastating, leaders in Northwest Colorado say](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Proposition 127, if passed, would ban the hunting of mountain lions, bobcats, and federally protected lynx, a move heavily criticized by wildlife experts and local officials.
* Opponents argue that this measure could lead to imbalances in predator-prey relationships, threatening Colorado's deer, elk, moose, and bighorn sheep populations.
* Critics also highlight that the initiative bypasses scientific wildlife management by Colorado Parks and Wildlife (CPW), favoring emotionally-driven decisions.
* Concerns have been raised about the financial implications, with opponents pointing out that hunting contributes to conservation efforts through fees, while predator overpopulation could lead to increased livestock losses.
* Wildlife experts and local commissioners emphasize the importance of relying on data-driven science rather than outside interests when it comes to wildlife management.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Trump vows to ‘end all sanctuary cities’ at ‘Faulkner Focus’ town hall with female voters](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [FOX NEWS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Trump vowed to end sanctuary cities and restore law and order during a town hall with female voters, addressing concerns about crime and public safety.
* He highlighted his lead over Harris on handling the economy, pledging to adjust tax policies to support families, particularly single parents.
* On abortion, Trump supported exceptions for rape, incest, and life-threatening cases, stressing the Supreme Court's decision to return the issue to the states.
* Trump also discussed immigration and foreign affairs, areas where he leads Harris, while she holds an edge on health care and climate change.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Donald Trump vows executive action to keep men off female sports teams](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [BREITBART](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* During a town hall in Georgia, Donald Trump vowed to ban men from participating in female sports teams and entering female spaces through executive action.
* When asked by a concerned grandmother, Trump emphasized that he would not allow biological men to compete in women's sports, referencing injuries sustained by female athletes in such situations.
* He mentioned a recent incident involving a college volleyball team refusing to play against a team with a transgender player as an example of the issue.
* Trump assured that as president, he would take immediate action to stop men from competing in women's sports.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Protesters insist Kellogg remove artificial dyes from cereals like Froot Loops, just like in Canada](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [FOX BUSINESS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Protesters gathered at WK Kellogg's headquarters in Michigan, demanding the company remove artificial dyes and preservatives from cereals sold in the U.S., such as Froot Loops and Apple Jacks.
* Kellogg had previously vowed to eliminate artificial ingredients by 2018, but continues to use them in U.S. products, despite using natural alternatives in Canada.
* Activists delivered a petition with over 420,000 signatures, citing concerns that artificial dyes contribute to behavioral issues in children.
* The U.S. FDA maintains that most children do not experience adverse effects from artificial additives, while Kellogg insists its products are safe and comply with federal regulations.
* Kellogg acknowledged differing consumer preferences across markets and said it would review the petition and share concerns with the FDA.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Ganahl: Retail rescue outed by a rabies outbreak](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY HEIDI GANAHL, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_Colorado’s animal rescue system has long been regarded as a national leader, rescuing tens of thousands of pets from outside the state each year to meet the growing demand for furry companions._ _
__However, a disturbing trend is emerging in the rescue world, where non-profit organizations posing as shelters are flipping animals in a scheme that values profits over the welfare of pets. This “retail rescue” phenomenon, coupled with lax quarantine and vaccination enforcement, has come to light in the wake of the Moms and Mutts (MAMCO) rabies outbreak, which has cost public health agencies over $600,000 to clean up._ **[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Sloan: Do we all – Democrats and Republicans – like nuclear now?](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY KELLY SLOAN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_We have not been afforded any authoritative glimpses into the proposed energy policies of either Mr. Trump or Ms. Harris, leaving us with only the conventional jousting positions with which to make comparisons._
_For Democrats, that generally means concerns over climate change exceeding every other consideration – meaning the minimizing of the use of oil and gas; for Republicans, it generally means strengthening national energy posture – meaning maximizing production of domestic supplies of oil and gas._
[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[Devotional: Don’t be a rebel. Engage in the process and vote.](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY DRAKE HUNTER, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_As we look ahead to our country’s future, it’s important to recognize the significant role that the government plays in shaping it._
_While there may be differing perspectives on this role, it’s undeniable that the government holds substantial influence over our collective destiny. We must envision the future and assess how our personal governance and contributions impact the well-being of our country._
_In Christianity, there is a profound belief in the ultimate authority resting in the hands or work of God. There’s a strong emphasis on the responsibility of followers to uphold the ‘Goodness’ of God, often referred to as ‘Governance.’ Governance works in tandem with preserving goodness; when functioning optimally, it’s seen as the Providence of God._
[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️**
**[Homeless are ‘dumpster diving’ and rural police chief wants trespassing law to stop it](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY BOBBIE DANIEL | LOCAL | OCTOBER 16** _A new measure could be added to Fort Morgan's criminal code in response to a homeless man who may nearly have been killed as a result of living inside a dumpster on trash pickup day._
**[Experts to debate Prop 131 (Ranked Choice Voting) at Oct. 18 event in Grand Junction](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **BY JEN SCHUMANN | STATE | OCTOBER 15** _With many Colorado voters already having ballots in hand, soon decisions will need to be made on a variety of ballot initiatives, not the least of which is Proposition 131._
**_[Raisch: When certifying election results, more transparency and better processes will reduce anxiety among voters](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)_** **BY MICHAEL L. RAISCH, CPA | STATE | OCTOBER 11** _We have all seen an increase in tension between people of different political beliefs over the last few years. We believe there are some common-sense solutions to help increase trust and tone down the rhetoric that comes out of the election process._

Hello,
Every time I see a new attack on abortion rights and women’s reproductive freedoms, I think of my dad.
For the first few years of my life, my family lived on an Indian reservation in Northern Montana. Dad was an OB-GYN – in the years before _Roe v. Wade_ ...
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95190271/505910792/1610638071?refcode=em20241017am-nd&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C35%2C50%2C100%2C250&refcode2=18882858-7f8c-ef11-8474-000d3a98fa6b&recurring=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjIxNiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxODg4Mjg1OC03ZjhjLWVmMTEtODQ3NC0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=aD4f_niXDTZMmGSY5eeqye5p-QSuuI66xZQiEVogSo0=)
Years later, Dad recounted how he saw patients that came from all walks of life. Black, brown, and white. Younger and older. Rich and poor. And just as many Republicans walked through his doors as did Democrats.
Looking back, having a father who provided women with access to health care – especially at a time when so many were being denied the right – really shaped how I think about the issue.
My dad is in his 80’s and retired now, but for years, he helped train the next generation of health care providers at Planned Parenthood. And my sister, who later also became an OB-GYN, is continuing on his legacy.
**Extremists like Lauren Boebert and my new Republican opponent want you to think that women having the freedom to make their own medical decisions is some extreme idea. It’s not.**
What’s extreme is pushing a bill in Congress that would make all abortions illegal – including in cases of rape or incest – and wanting to ban a medication that’s been approved for decades for abortions and miscarriages.
Their views are a fringe one – supported by people who think that the government should be dictating women’s medical decisions, instead of allowing women the freedom to make choices with their doctor.
I would have thought that after almost losing this seat last year, they might have at least pretended to moderate on this issue. But they've only doubled down on the extreme.
**Only 546 votes separated Lauren Boebert and me in 2022, and I’m ready to finish the job in 2024 by winning this seat in Congress.**

clean_body: Every time I see a new attack on abortion rights and women’s reproductive freedoms, I think of my dad. Hello, Every time I see a new attack on abortion rights and women’s reproductive freedoms, I think of my dad. For the first few years of my life, my family lived on an Indian reservation in Northern Montana. Dad was an OB-GYN – in the years before Roe v. Wade ... = Years later, Dad recounted how he saw patients that came from all walks of life. Black, brown, and white. Younger and older. Rich and poor. And just as many Republicans walked through his doors as did Democrats. Looking back, having a father who provided women with access to health care – especially at a time when so many were being denied the right – really shaped how I think about the issue. My dad is in his 80’s and retired now, but for years, he helped train the next generation of health care providers at Planned Parenthood. And my sister, who later also became an OB-GYN, is continuing on his legacy. Extremists like Lauren Boebert and my new Republican opponent want you to think that women having the freedom to make their own medical decisions is some extreme idea. It’s not. What’s extreme is pushing a bill in Congress that would make all abortions illegal – including in cases of rape or incest – and wanting to ban a medication that’s been approved for decades for abortions and miscarriages. Their views are a fringe one – supported by people who think that the government should be dictating women’s medical decisions, instead of allowing women the freedom to make choices with their doctor. I would have thought that after almost losing this seat last year, they might have at least pretended to moderate on this issue. But they've only doubled down on the extreme. Only 546 votes separated Lauren Boebert and me in 2022, and I’m ready to finish the job in 2024 by winning this seat in Congress. = Please use the links in this email to start a weekly donation through ActBlue: | | = | = | | = | = | | = | = Thank you for letting me share some of my story with you. | Peter, We have a problem in New Jersey. People are leaving in droves. According to United Van Lines, [people hired their movers to leave New Jersey more](https://xtz223.keap-link007.com/v2/click/72cb1d807987eea945f9a9e611539ff0/eJyNkM0OgjAQhN9lzyBSMCo3YgwhqAejZ9PARhuhNO1q_QnvblHjSROPk_1mJrN3IJRcUl5BAhe6MRaBBxpLoQRKmrWSePm8slEcRqEHtZDHTLcnBcn9q_kDPF3TeOgBXRU6ZLNOZ0W-ynaLfFU4UnHtOv7MYfEnZ75M8wV03c9gbATNzy7bQEL6hP2iSrhVtNW14w9EyiRBYK0dSLTGIh4HZdsEGo2oep9fIz8LufcNcUKf11w3vdS9CifjYcxGrogrhbJ6f6nA66uuewCyWHDM) than any other region in 2023. In particular, many retirees are deciding that it is too expensive to live in the Garden State–they’re leaving and taking their income with them. This shouldn’t be surprising. Phil Murphy’s authoritarian policies and sky-high taxes (including [the highest property taxes](https://xtz223.keap-link007.com/v2/click/ae280cf121411a4f8a34bc613a9fbc98/eJyNUU1PwzAM_S9B3JqVdeVAJQ5TmabSsQMCcUSmsZrsIwmJu61M47fjDbQTSFxiP-f52U_eC0ILliolCrGjjywbiUQEbIw3aKl0lqA5_WbX-XA0TMTK2OU0uM6LYv9r85lw6rrJs0RQ75EpT4_jsq7m09dZNa-Z6SHwjH_qZPlZZ_IwrmbicPhTGNeGJhvWjqKg0OHRkTLsip7DivmayMciTe3izcDAhTa1Tq6BCIPUbisVEEgTZRM622hU0i6kD85joF4S7DBKXl1q02qMlF4UnwXhjm7nuL3Mru4xROw5CRiNOm7BuYYNciCNCYFdHisI6r2DwENRMTaWnxeI2tiWHIOS8d2gZD_gPVr1c4wa-29Xhy84aJP3) in the country) are making New Jersey unlivable. So what is Murphy’s solution? Is it to rein in government spending to help the economy? Is it to lower taxes? Or maybe Murphy will fix some of the many broken government programs (like our transit system) to entice people to stay. Of course, it’s none of these things. Typically, Murphy wants to throw more money at the situation! He is attempting to buy people off in order to keep them in the state through the “Stay NJ” plan. “Stay NJ” [is billed as a “property tax relief” program](https://xtz223.keap-link007.com/v2/click/58474c25d4a7dab38f7c1cb9a237b7f1/eJyNkM2ugkAMRt-la2B0xMVlZwwxBHVhvGszQiOjMDRDFdHw7o4_0Y03ucum5ztf2iswGmU4ySGCM1-kHIEHFjNNGg1Pa8Mqe2zlOByOhh6U2hxmtj4SRNev4TfwSP2EoQfcETpkvZpM02Q528yTZepIUtZ1_NMjP554MUnm0Pd_irHSHJ-cu4GI7RHvF-XaXcW_tnR8wUxNJETbtoHZB1ldCYNtI-RAhmIgBRfob_XOJ1sTWu58Vuf7UOkGg4Kr0nUoIjT560Epds-m_gYl7W5z) for elderly residents set to take effect in 2026. But where’s this money going to come from? This has all the billings of an unfunded empty promise. All “Stay NJ” does is put lipstick on the pig of yet another expensive government program. Not to mention, there is little bipartisan support for this bill, which was rammed through before the election. **We have to put a stop to this before it goes too far–and we need your help to do so.[Contact your state representatives today](https://xtz223.keap-link007.com/v2/click/71ca83f18aac4e8df899e1524d1d74cb/eJyNkE0LgkAQhv_LnE3JLMibhIRoHaLOsehQW7Yuu6P2gf-9ycJTQbcZ5plneOcBhEooSgoI4Up335-AAwZzqSUqWlSKRN5P_WkwnowdKKU6L01VawgfX5cHoN-aBzMH6KaRke0mWqTJernPknXKpBaGb_zp8YPBE6-iJIOu-ynGi6S4YbeFkEyNr0SF5FS0MyXzRyJtQ89r29ZVpxIPriVByLVbW497aUtBssGRqSyhYaXQGlXx-UeKt7e4ewJVY2nB) and let them know we need to get rid of “Stay NJ.” ** Not sure who your representatives are? Find out [here](https://xtz223.keap-link007.com/v2/click/46f2a215835ec412215711f55b7edd54/eJyNkE0LgkAQhv_LnE1JDcqbhIhoHqLOsehQW7ouu2Nm4n9v-8BTQbeBed5neGcAQsEEJSUEcKO763pggcKCS46C1o0gVry27sKfe3MLKi4usWpaCcHwNTwBr9TKX1pAvUSD7LbhOk3y-JAleWpIyZS58afH9SdPtAmTDMbxpxhrTtHVuDUEpFp8Niq5aUV7VRn-RCR14Dhd19niXOHR1sQIzWy32im5JsULmtVMGhmTEkX5-USK_Vs5PgDYX2cv)! We should be focused on decreasing our government spending and shrinking government control to allow small businesses to thrive. The last thing we need is another money-draining government pay out. We need to get loud against our state’s insane overspending problem NOW! In defiance and strength, Elizabeth Nader

body:
Have you heard what our opponents are saying?
Jon Tester and Sherrod Brown here. We’re in the middle of some pretty tight races in Ohio and Montana that you’ve probably heard about. But have you heard what our opponents are saying? 👇
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/78228?refcode=em20241017-8105&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=8105%2E614464%2EfUBfU2)
Bernie Moreno, said it's **"a little crazy"** that women in Ohio are voting to defend reproductive rights. Tim Sheehy thinks young women who care about abortion access are **“indoctrinated.”**
You read that right. They have once again shown us exactly who they are – extremists who will put their own out-of-touch agenda before the health and safety of women _everywhere._
And the difference between us could not be more clear: We know these decisions should be left between a woman and her doctor, and that no government official, _least of all these two_ , should be forcing their way into the doctor’s office.
We believe women should have the freedom to make their own health care decisions, while Bernie Moreno and Tim Sheehy think _they_ should get the final say. If they get elected, they would be the deciding votes for a national abortion ban. We cannot let that happen.
**_But record-breaking money is pouring into Montana and Ohio, spreading lies all over the airwaves. We set a Big Sky Buckeye Fund goal of $3 million because that’s what it’s going to take to fight back against their attacks._ [Will you rush $10 or $15 right now to protect reproductive rights and win in Ohio and Montana?](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/78228?refcode=em20241017-8105&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=8105%2E614464%2EfUBfU2)**
Together, we can get this done but we don’t have much time.
Thanks for all of your support,
Jon Tester & Sherrod Brown

### "We Choose Us" Network Targets Rice, Olmsted, Blue Earth and Freeborn Counties for Political Narrative Messaging

---
Who would have expected the likes of the ex-wife of Jeff Bazos, [MacKenzie Scott](https://substack.com/redirect/35e28a6c-461a-44b9-9a5f-c974f68718c6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), to play a role in Southern Minnesota Politics? Yet, it appears that her activist contributions are being funnelled through a complex financial maze to support a political advocacy network in Minnesota. This political narrative is being led by a pair of organizations called "[We Choose Us](https://substack.com/redirect/6a5f514e-5574-47eb-85d5-d148c28d1d21?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" and "We Choose Us Action." This politically-driven duo is [described ](https://substack.com/redirect/909b45cf-8ba0-40cd-b277-11283e9888d9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)as, "a Democratic-affiliated opposition coalition -- backed by secret donors -- who were working quietly to counteract the election deniers."
The _**We Choose Us**_ politicial network has now been popping up in Southern Minnesota as they campaign under the false flag of "Democracy Defense." In some cases, their local members are being asked to escalate the temperature of public meetings to "show up en masse to events." I have received first hand reports of _**We Choose Us**_ members showing up at public meetings booing when questions were asked, and interrupting public comments from other citizens.
#### Who is "We Choose Us"
On May 2, 2023 "**We Choose Us Action** " was filed as an assumed name subordinate supported by its "fiscal sponsor" Faith in Minnesota - a 501(c)(4)1 As described by [Influence Watch](https://substack.com/redirect/7b84dbe9-219e-4355-9e47-b74611cc695c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), "We **Choose Us Action** is fiscally sponsored by Faith in Minnesota, the political action arm of [ISAIAH](https://substack.com/redirect/8a5fea6d-a7c6-453a-a326-f6d9f8d30783?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), an activist organization based in Minnesota that recruits left-of-center activists from church congregations in order to advance a number of left-of-center policy priorities."
On May 5, 2023, "**We Choose Us** " was filed as an assumed name subordinate supported by its "fiscal sponsor", ISAIAH, a member of the Faith in Action Network, a 501(c)(3) based in Washington D.C.
In [Dark Money](https://substack.com/redirect/8a32213f-63d2-4275-80e3-8728d133ceff?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) terminology, using these types of "project pairs" allows an organization to maximize the most useful characteristics of a 501(c)(3) non-profit, whose donors may write off their donations as tax deductible, and a 501(c)(4) group which may spend significantly more on lobbying. (In addition, tax laws make the 501(c)(3) organization much easier for private foundations to fund than a 501(c)(4). 2
Likewise, by using "pop-up", or assumed name organizations, their fiscal sponsors can add another layer of anonymity to their activities.
As further [reported](https://substack.com/redirect/7b84dbe9-219e-4355-9e47-b74611cc695c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by Influence Watch, and consistent with the dark nature of this structure, "There is no available financial information related to We Choose Us Action or We Choose Us." One [article](https://substack.com/redirect/909b45cf-8ba0-40cd-b277-11283e9888d9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) from January, 2023, however, described the _**We Choose Us**_ duo as follows, "The well-organized, slick campaign didn't just spontaneously spring from the ground, however. It's part of a $32 million nationwide campaign that began before the midterms..."
#### Enter Mackenzie Scott funnelling money into political causes in Minnesota
In March of this year, we saw a [#mediabuzz](https://substack.com/redirect/b295cd8f-c230-40d4-9793-a2c031e43e78?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) over Scott's grants 3of millions to at least 8 Minnesota organizations through her [Yield Giving ](https://substack.com/redirect/62a16a2d-f574-4c73-9e98-734b4f525c31?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)network. This organization boasts a total outlay of, "$17,300,000,000 to 2,300+ non-profit teams" throughout the Country. One of the benefited organizations funded by Scott's network was a $2 million grant to ISAIAH, a Federation4 partner of Faith In Action.org. In the Yield Giving [explanation](https://substack.com/redirect/e53a2e98-5309-484d-acc2-2030e187ba1c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), the ISAIAH grant was tagged with the following catagories - civic and social engagement, democracy, and race and ethnicity.
ISAIAH was then free to redeploy this grant money to its surbordinate organizations, including _**We Choose Us**_. The watchdog organization, Influence Watch, [describes](https://substack.com/redirect/8a5fea6d-a7c6-453a-a326-f6d9f8d30783?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) the ISAIAH model as follows:
> The Foundation uses religious coalitions to advance left-of-center activism and helps set up local activist groups which then hide their connection to the Foundation, allowing it to be "invisible" in order to make its campaigns appear to be grassroots-led.
Consistent with this local activist smoke-screen model, _**We Choose Us**_ held a Democracy Defense Summit in June of this year. During this summit, they trained and planned for the deployment of local citizens to act as conduits to promote the political narrative of their fiscal sponsor, ISAIAH; using Google money from the one of the wealthiest individuals in the Country.
#### Deployment of the "Grass-roots" smoke-screen
We are now witnessing the deployment of the "grass-roots" representatives of the _**We Choose Us**_ narrative network. The image below shows the County-specific action plan being implemented by this well-funded, and well organized, political messaging effort.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7a9e88df-34d8-46dc-b4dd-b53a1a424b0e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Recently, **We Choose Us** grass-roots front people [appeared](https://substack.com/redirect/03b6473c-90c6-40f8-a862-4b0cbfd3b902?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in St. Louis County. More politcal narrative messaging events are planned between now and the November 5th election. Just a word to the wise, the individuals that are being deployed as concerned citizens are being used as a smoke-screen for a much larger purpose. While these individuals may very well be good-intentioned, they are proably unaware that they are part of a schem to leverage dark money to promote a political cause and narrative.
Finally, in case you continue to question whether the _**We Choose Us**_ network is politically active and motivated please check out this facebook post from October 27, 2022.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/9ecd6cfd-71d5-49fd-bd80-386e43f8032b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
1
The website opensecrets.org describes these organizations as follows: "**501(c)(4) groups:** Often referred to as "social welfare" organizations, these nonprofits are the most common kind of dark money group."
2
Walter, Scott, _Arabella The Dark Money Network of Leftist Billionaires Secretly Transforming America_ , page 20.
3
Again, as explained by opensecrets.org, "**Political Grantmaking** Another way they get around spending too much on politics is by making large grants to like-minded groups. This _grant_ expenditure is considered part of the organization's primary purpose budget. These grants can serve two purposes: (1) The grant recipient can then spend a portion of the donor's money on political advocacy; and (2) A recipient organization's overall budget grows larger, allowing it to spend more money on political activity." Peter, Since day one, Hung has been the best husband and father for our family.
I’m so grateful for his dedication to our family and country.

Now, he’s ready to be the best U.S. Senator for Virginia - and here’s how I know he’s up for the job.

Hung always puts others before himself. Whether it’s the sacrifices he made serving in the U.S. Navy to always making time for our five children, he does everything he can to make sure our country and our family are taken care of.

He always says what he means, and he’s not afraid to make hard decisions. Hung isn’t afraid to get the job done - even when it means ruffling feathers.

I admire his honesty, his bravery, and his dedication to defending the American Dream for our children.

**T[his race is going to be one of Hung’s toughest battles yet, and he needs your help. Will you endorse Hung right now?>>](http://links.hungcaoforva.com/u/click?_t=c514f30bd6cd4b1bb0e09a0456675c53&_m=4dd8fa00bad347918d92b831515bd813&_e=mzvctPx38WCnxktDCnc21f-1Y5l-Wux_YwfEnM_olaOXpniC5BVkxLlwwnO_KZbFON4jZ5fNvk5Qh5LUawoM_yzGOKZQ8asQGZA_p8ThMY4DQz6JzcuIuaWYtv4XAT0NDPB6xFRJofReoFBdinmJv4k3hrJT6EnvZyVMP_5gV969gDGbv71y41qSGxZ0oP0Ux74mbrVNVy35TTdJWO_mnQ_nqhLlTOvqX8o252nd22JSA1NRc4ydtxCVGw4ZTUnZPY1H990DO3dJ9FCPPIn-QnfIWubkGFdgP7Eje4xbsNRmpmZ534plahUfkz-YTHSMTEScLFcn5S3c7-xWPJazPIq5dtXxZZlhjn5s6P4NGHERw12LqyNjbj0rruE-96lXlOX8-M6B97ltJmDidCbubQ%3D%3D)**

This isn’t just about politics for Hung, Peter. This is personal.

Hung knows the American Dream is possible - because he’s lived it.

He came to America not knowing a word of English after escaping Communist Vietnam. By the time he graduated high school, he had a spot at the U.S. Naval Academy.

He owes his life to America, and he’s paid it back every way possible.

But just because his career in the Navy is over doesn’t mean he’s done fighting.

This isn’t the news I wanted to share,
Peter. We weren’t able to hit our
final FEC fundraising goal of the campaign before the deadline expired
last night.

Now, the sky isn’t falling just because we missed this goal. And I’m not
going to scare you, trick you, or guilt you into making a donation —
that’s not how we do things here.

Hovde wrote himself another $7 million check last quarter and Mitch
McConnell’s super PAC launched a $24 million ad blitz in Wisconsin.

into a multi-million-dollar personal fortune like my opponent can.
Instead, I rely on folks like you who pitch in what you can, when you can,

body:
Now, that’s not one I use every day.

*|MC_PREVIEW_TEXT|* |
---
| | [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z932nji196khv1o47o2v4qacd601rmbsudao674o_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4shge1o34c5h2bs "SkyTree Book Fairs")
Hi Friend,

I like to keep one of those old-school Word of the Day tools around as a way to learn something new every day, and today’s word is _insalubrious_.

Now, that’s not one I use every day. In fact, I had to look it up.

And the definition is: unhealthy and unwholesome.

As in, _“Scholastic books fairs push insalubrious content on America’s children.”_

What a great way to describe the ever-growing selection of Scholastic books featuring LGBTQIA+ and gender-transitioning storylines and critical race theory themes, just to name a few.

**I’m not making this up! Keep on reading and see for yourself the books Scholastic is promoting to kids as young as 4 years old!**

If you’re fed up with the _insalubrious_ nature of the books featured in your local book fair, I invite you to join the SkyTree Book Fairs family tree!

[Help SkyTree Book Fairs reach our goal of providing 150 book fairs this fall semester! Your gift of $10, $35, $50, or more today will put a wholesome, age-appropriate book into the hands of a child. Click to donate now >>](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zd43q4vov8lf5f2k4fvvf0dngjas37gh0qe2ru4g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4shge1o34c5h2bs)
[Donate](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2ze5s6u8islr0lb1u65j6dvo6s4v1oghb0hfeit8o_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4shge1o34c5h2bs)
SkyTree Book Fairs was founded in 2023 as the safe and reliable alternative to Scholastic’s monopoly in the school book fair market.

Unlike Scholastic, all of our book fairs are offered _free of charge_ to schools and contain only age-appropriate books that my team has personally vetted. My team and I are committed to featuring wholesome, uplifting books with stories that foster imagination while being rooted in truth.

Since our founding, we’ve already...
* Set up over 280 book fairs in 23 states
* Reviewed and added 300+ titles to our book fair collection
* **Impacted over 30,000 students, with plans to reach 50,000 more this fall!**

I knew when SkyTree was founded that the book fair market needed an alternative to Scholastic, but demand has grown rapidly as parents, grandparents, and librarians realize the harm that Scholastic’s _insalubrious_ content does to kids.

Scholastic is sneaky about their agenda, burying inappropriate content amidst innocent book offerings like _The Babysitters Club_ and _Captain Underpants_. Many of the books that Scholastic publishes or promotes in their book fairs and online catalogs include subject matter that should never be presented to children.

Like these titles from their _Power of Story_ line, an agenda-driven line of children’s books that may show up in school book fairs and libraries this year:
* For PreK - Grade 3:
* _You Are Brave: A Book About Trying New Things_ \- encourages kids to show the world how brave they are with LGBTQIA+ messaging.
* For Grades 3-7:
* _Asking for a Friend_ \- a story about queer joy and all the ups and downs of true friendship.
* For Grades 7 & Up:
* _Cut_ \- a glimpse inside the mind of a 15-year-old girl who cuts herself
* _Escape from St. Hell: My Trans Teen Life Levels Up: A Graphic Novel_ \- this one pretty much speaks for itself...

At SkyTree Book Fairs, we believe that book fairs should offer books that _**let kids be kids**_ , not books aimed at indoctrinating them with radical ideologies.

[Friend, will you join me in the fight to protect children’s innocence? Even just $10 puts my team closer to meeting our goal of 150 book fairs this fall. Chip in your best gift now! >>](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z9rbf513r4khqql3glvb5u535geunsr84b05fqoo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4shge1o34c5h2bs)

Growing up presents enough challenges. Kids certainly don’t need to have their minds filled with the confusing, disturbing, and _insalubrious_ content Scholastic will be bringing to schools across the country this semester.

The good news is that across the country, moms and dads are waking up to indoctrination going on in their children’s schools and demanding better. They’re demanding SkyTree Book Fairs.

And I couldn’t be more excited to share our wholesome book fair experience, but I need your help!

I’ve set a big, hairy, audacious goal of raising $200,000 to fully fund the over 150 book fairs scheduled in the fall semester. To keep bringing these fairs to schools free of charge, I’m relying on your generosity.

**Help SkyTree Book Fairs end Scholastic’s monopoly on the book fair market! **

body:
| | | |
---
| FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE THURSDAY, OCTOBER 17
GREATER GEORGIA LAUNCHES GET OUT THE VOTE CAMPAIGN FOR PRESIDENT TRUMP
(ATLANTA) - Today, Greater Georgia launched a get-out-the-vote (GOTV) campaign urging conservatives to vote for Donald Trump by casting a ballot between now and Election Day. The campaign, which includes digital ads, text messages, postcards, and phone calls, is targeting the same voters that Greater Georgia has been engaging for months - including minority voters, young voters, and newly registered voters. Following the devastation of Hurricane Helene, the organization is also investing to mobilize conservatives in storm-impacted counties.
"For four years, Greater Georgia has worked to register voters, win over diverse communities, and increase voter confidence. Now, our mission is to get those voters to the polls and turn years' worth of engagement and infrastructure into votes," said Greater Georgia Chairwoman and former U.S. Senator Kelly Loeffler. "Already, this new conservative coalition has helped drive record turnout in the first days of early voting - and, with sustained encouragement from our organization, they will help deliver the November election for President Trump."
Prior to launching its GOTV effort, Greater Georgia invested $100,000 to engage Black, Hispanic, Asian, and young voters by highlighting the failures of Kamala Harris. Separately, the organization invested over $100,000 to register voters. In the weeks leading up to the election, the group will work to drive these same voters to the polls with a simple message emphasizing the importance of their participation in a state where the last presidential election was decided by less than 12,000 votes. The group will also invest to mobilize south Georgia conservatives in hurricane-impacted counties.

Recent [polling](https://fsdy8nbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001khyRDrgyaBlHQhcn1NrCRTmSHwdUrTkV8dx_NUUaPLHU1n5LWp-6eOI2Wk7bGb9iSlCeF2vqUxnX_n-O6KfHzUMUDu0TNiuQYUQMxAsYBhQooTOtVYNFKMeZ2UUWtuOoAbsvJpu-bgGeeVrlifwgjAEukKXnX2RCtv7ajpLF0F6RwYxtjCVxKbzs-nvUWm-CrzF_1x2iGiKw8EZmnlhyHoi3dcz0uDpBFGj-hu81z2XwqiiaxN5lCxfQHdkAOa56&c=BoeOl_cJccdD-T8WOQfpaMI80D9RXFP6wz-41J1b_oYky4bjDWacyA==&ch=Rf23KfDScAZofJtTUXsfIkGnf2xHYk5DLQTSR-dLujdkGFAwmIRItg==) suggests the potential for meaningful gains within Greater Georgia's target universe. 51% of Georgia voters aged 18-29 say they plan to vote for President Trump. Meanwhile, just 77% of Black Georgians plan to vote for Kamala Harris.

I just wrapped up a meeting with my finance team, and they told me we fell short of our mid-October fundraising target by just a handful of donations. And with only 19 days until Election Day, we’re feeling the pinch. There’s no room to slow down now. From digital outreach to canvassing and keeping our TV ads live across Tennessee, every part of our strategy is vital. We can’t afford to make budget cuts when our GOTV efforts are at their peak. This race could be a game-changer. It’s a critical year for control of the Senate, and our outcome could either protect the Democratic majority or hand it over to far-right extremists. Marsha Blackburn and her corporate allies are counting on us falling behind, but I’m not giving up. I believe in this team, and I believe in the people of Tennessee. subject: We hope this explanation helps.
body:
Here’s where things stand:
---
Derek, In just a moment, we’re going to ask you to [**donate $3 directly to the Democratic National Committee.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-october-elect-dems-2024?amount=3&refcode=em_20241017_1932_fr&refcode2=1932_22930333_yKZ4L_&akid=1932%2E22930333%2EyKZ4L_) Please give us a chance to explain why this request is so important. Here’s where things stand: Polling shows that the presidential race is close. **_Extremely close._** In some polls, Kamala Harris leads Trump by a few points. In others, she’s trailing. Some even show a tie. With the margins this close, we cannot afford to lose ground anywhere. This means we need to stay competitive in multiple battleground states to maximize our chances of winning. And that requires a massive amount of resources. Just a handful of votes in a couple of states could be the difference between winning and losing on November 5. With Election Day less than three weeks away and early voting already underway, we are running out of time to persuade the voters who will make all the difference. On top of that, Trump and his allies are spending millions attacking Kamala Harris, Tim Walz, and Democrats up and down the ballot on television and online. This makes it even harder for us to break through. This is why our fundraising goals are so important. name: Douglas Carswell
subject: Opinion Article about Tim Walz’s record as Governor
body:
| | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mspolicy/msla-11573233?e=5703353baa)
---
| |
---
| Dear Friend, I wanted to share with you my latest column in the Telegraph below.
---
|
---
The United States is now less than a month away from what looks likely to be an extraordinarily close presidential election.

In the handful of swing states that will decide the outcome, Donald Trump and his running mate, JD Vance, are running neck and neck against Kamala Harris and Tim Walz, the governor of Minnesota.

Supposedly solid and dependable, Walz was picked by the Democrats to appeal to middle America. He was expected to be a counterweight to some of Kamala’s kookiness. Unfortunately, things have not turned out quite how Democrat strategists intended.
|
---
| Walz has proved to have what you might charitably call an awkward demeanor. Less kindly, you might say he’s straight up odd.

Nervous during his TV debate against JD Vance, he managed to blurt out that he was “friends with school shooters”. Questioned about claims he had made that he was in Hong Kong at the time of the Tiananmen square massacre, his long and rambling answer looked and sounded shifty.

But it’s Walz’s record as governor in Minnesota that is proving even more awkward for Team Kamala.
Walz has been active in Minnesota politics for almost two decades, serving as a congressman for the state before becoming governor in 2019. How has Minnesota fared under governor Tim Walz?

Minnesota, for perhaps the first time in its 166 year history, is losing people. At a time when the population of America is growing, the Gopher State is flirting with demographic decline. People from every income group, apart from those at the very bottom, are leaving in significant numbers according to IRS data.

You might imagine that Minnesota is one of those wealthy mid-Western states. It certainly used to be. But one analysis suggests that, in 2023, Minnesota’s per capita income fell below the US national average for the first time.

One reason that the state has stalled economically could be that energy costs in Minnesota are now sky high. Perhaps thanks in part to Governor Walz’s renewable energy agenda, electricity prices have shot up – even if they have not yet reached the sort of levels you see in Europe. This has hit energy intensive industries hard.

Minnesota once had a relatively low crime rate. No longer. Minneapolis, the city where George Floyd died after that notorious confrontation with the police soon after Tim Walz became governor, was at the epicenter of the Black Lives Matter protests that followed. The city suffered extensive damage, and one of the city’s police precinct buildings was overrun. It still has not fully recovered.

Rather than stand up to the anti-police movement in the aftermath of the protests, Walz and the local Democrat leadership were accused of appeasing it. Local police forces have since struggled to recruit and retain officers willing to serve. Crime in urban Minnesota skyrocketed. The state was recently found to have a higher crime rate than the US national average.

Walz, who famously presents himself as an educator, has also appeased teacher union interests in the state. His governorship has been a disaster for public education. Despite spending per student increasing significantly on Walz’s watch, proficiency in math and reading have plummeted.

As governor, he has seemed to defer to all the Leftist interest groups, from the anti police protesters and public prosecutors, to the green energy lobby and the teacher unions. If his priorities in Minnesota prove to be the same as the priorities for any future administration in Washington, expect to see such interest groups indulged at a federal level, too.

If Walz’s Minnesota proves a microcosm of what America under a Kamala Harris presidency is to become, America will be much worse off as a result.

**_Douglas Carswell is the President & CEO of the Mississippi Center for Public Policy, one of the leading state-based think tanks in America. _**

Minnesota, for perhaps the first time in its 166 year history, is losing people. At a time when the population of America is growing, the Gopher State is flirting with demographic decline. People from every income group, apart from those at the very bottom, are leaving in significant numbers according to IRS data. You might imagine that Minnesota is one of those wealthy mid-Western states. It certainly used to be. But one analysis suggests that, in 2023, Minnesota’s per capita income fell below the US national average for the first time. One reason that the state has stalled economically could be that energy costs in Minnesota are now sky high. Perhaps thanks in part to Governor Walz’s renewable energy agenda, electricity prices have shot up – even if they have not yet reached the sort of levels you see in Europe. This has hit energy intensive industries hard. Minnesota once had a relatively low crime rate. No longer. Minneapolis, the city where George Floyd died after that notorious confrontation with the police soon after Tim Walz became governor, was at the epicenter of the Black Lives Matter protests that followed. The city suffered extensive damage, and one of the city’s police precinct buildings was overrun. It still has not fully recovered. Rather than stand up to the anti-police movement in the aftermath of the protests, Walz and the local Democrat leadership were accused of appeasing it. Local police forces have since struggled to recruit and retain officers willing to serve. Crime in urban Minnesota skyrocketed. The state was recently found to have a higher crime rate than the US national average. Walz, who famously presents himself as an educator, has also appeased teacher union interests in the state. His governorship has been a disaster for public education. Despite spending per student increasing significantly on Walz’s watch, proficiency in math and reading have plummeted. As governor, he has seemed to defer to all the Leftist interest groups, from the anti police protesters and public prosecutors, to the green energy lobby and the teacher unions. If his priorities in Minnesota prove to be the same as the priorities for any future administration in Washington, expect to see such interest groups indulged at a federal level, too. If Walz’s Minnesota proves a microcosm of what America under a Kamala Harris presidency is to become, America will be much worse off as a result. Douglas Carswell is the President & CEO of the Mississippi Center for Public Policy, one of the leading state-based think tanks in America. | "Forward this email to a friend!" | | Warm regards, Douglas Carswell President & CEO | | |

Peter,

I’m thrilled and honored that the National Border Patrol Council (NBPC) has endorsed me for Congress!

New Mexico’s Second Congressional District encompasses 180 miles of the southern border with Mexico – _**we’re on the front lines and are the first ones affected** by Kamala Harris’s and Gabe Vasquez’s flat-out REFUSAL to secure our borders and combat illegal immigration._

The Border Patrol knows where I stand (and where I always have): **with them, with President Trump, with the YOU American people, and with our nation’s sovereignty and security.**

[ ** Help Yvette Secure the Border! **](http://links.yvetteherrell.com/u/click?_t=60a077210c21435397f83f8f2527f964&_m=6027864a51404af4b5be5fe739037a6a&_e=RvPS0ScwwprduI2l5GXybQ8WU7TNRCIMY8y9IKjC9LyZdPC6oPzcf2WNHSD12g6oBNcYzAMChjSUz11tF8n-oe_UPMbL83P585Iev0l2wyYhFZ2ytRWrR70pxvroGMQ6Pbp3m96IMZoB1ZXuEg9y6dsng0Vv8-VsU6lX4nGGZltejZyPdIAY9Jv_SOPjrbEct6n2q2ppT27mMMceNa5WeH8ZL17USgjLjlmIKD1ga9bPRl53V5pArAo-L43yxkKNnbVKCwwYzec2z1kV1awe-H34eB3cBSbDEQHW_YaAG22SnUnMCWuI-6ujoEqnNvlW5fv769Z8-nGi7waLGAU8KAEFOmxN8eloLj-U3qQPA79kkqbkMM-RO-DqIrCDwexh)
Here’s what NBPC President Paul Perez had to say:

> _“The National Border Patrol Council is proud to endorse Yvette Herrell for Congress in New Mexico's 2nd Congressional District. Yvette is a proven champion for the men and women of the NBPC, and a strong advocate for effective border security policies. Now more than ever, we need Yvette back in Congress to fight for us. We urge all voters in New Mexico's 2nd District who want secure borders and support law enforcement to join us in supporting Yvette Herrell for Congress.”_

I‘m proud to have their support, and now I must ask for your continued support in this fight so we can finally secure our borders and oust Vasquez and Harris. [**Can you chip in with a critical campaign contribution today?**](http://links.yvetteherrell.com/u/click?_t=60a077210c21435397f83f8f2527f964&_m=6027864a51404af4b5be5fe739037a6a&_e=RvPS0ScwwprduI2l5GXybQ8WU7TNRCIMY8y9IKjC9LyZdPC6oPzcf2WNHSD12g6oBNcYzAMChjSUz11tF8n-oe_UPMbL83P585Iev0l2wyYhFZ2ytRWrR70pxvroGMQ6Pbp3m96IMZoB1ZXuEg9y6dsng0Vv8-VsU6lX4nGGZltejZyPdIAY9Jv_SOPjrbEct6n2q2ppT27mMMceNa5WeH8ZL17USgjLjlmIKD1ga9YU-gSTcUwi22RAbpE8VqMjFVH0vl-LXc7saYG2hnDGNs8BFdLouoGuMSFkqtis_WKK5jBORKRpwoQ-TnDTccphj4iuDAR_EpOjxqH19nT_eQfXuNBxhO4WpV_PMurwLjU17r9ZUGOvqxgEjdkANvGr)

[ ** Help Yvette Secure the Border! **](http://links.yvetteherrell.com/u/click?_t=60a077210c21435397f83f8f2527f964&_m=6027864a51404af4b5be5fe739037a6a&_e=RvPS0ScwwprduI2l5GXybQ8WU7TNRCIMY8y9IKjC9LyZdPC6oPzcf2WNHSD12g6oBNcYzAMChjSUz11tF8n-oe_UPMbL83P585Iev0l2wyYhFZ2ytRWrR70pxvroGMQ6Pbp3m96IMZoB1ZXuEg9y6dsng0Vv8-VsU6lX4nGGZltejZyPdIAY9Jv_SOPjrbEct6n2q2ppT27mMMceNa5WeH8ZL17USgjLjlmIKD1ga9YjWDTt5Vv2Q6trQhBWz669WoX2oDTv39mXciOLOKIBOrVFO_Q6V2uOO1c9ic8uU1cxePnCnfOtJswfQxpu82I9uYJply1EPRWq2-KZ_jEZYiOQ62q1fU9ZaigAZdodJFT3c5Ngu82y1JKCqvdZpQy_)
The NBPC’s decision to endorse me over Gabe Vasquez, goes without saying, but here are just a few reasons...

Gabe Vasquez:

* Called the border crisis a “non-existent threat."
* Called efforts to secure the border “ill-informed” and “in bad taste.”
* Called to eliminate ICE, claiming it has “no regard for humanity.”
* Said the border wall was built by a “crooked, racist administration.”
* Applauded Biden for halting construction on the wall.
* Called border security a “racist, environmentally destructive, massive waste of money.”
* Said border security measures were “a glorification of xenophobia.”

| | Peter – one accusation changed the trajectory of my family's life forever. My great-grandfather courageously stood up for someone who was wrongfully accused of a crime. It was 1959 in South Carolina, and out of revenge, my great-grandfather was murdered. While dealing with the loss of my great-grandfather, my entire family soon came under threat, and so my great-grandmother packed the car and fled to Maryland to find a new home. My great-grandmother had every reason to be bitter and feel hopeless. But I always remember her telling me this story and sharing with me: “If you don’t like something, you go farther and you do better.” [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/32809?t=11&amount=25&akid=2950%2E52803%2EJhUVq3) I’ve spent my life trying to live up to my great-grandmother’s words. I became a State’s Attorney to seek justice for Maryland families, and I’ve been proudly serving as a county executive to improve the lives of my neighbors. **Only in America could three generations separate a woman forced to flee the South, to now me running to become the first Black senator for the great state of Maryland. People like me, stories like mine, don’t often make it to the United States Senate — but they should.[So if you’re with me in this fight, please pitch in $25 to my campaign right now.](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/32809?t=12&amount=25&akid=2950%2E52803%2EJhUVq3)** | | | [Donate](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/32809?t=13&amount=25&akid=2950%2E52803%2EJhUVq3)

I’m running for Senate to ensure that our families feel safe, that our children have a brighter future ahead, and that our fundamental freedoms are protected.
But Mitch McConnell personally recruited Larry Hogan (R) to defeat me because he thought it was his best shot at flipping the Senate red. They’ve had far-right Super PACs pouring millions into this race to try and buy this election.
We are building a people-powered movement to bring a better future to Maryland, and I hope that you will join us today, Peter.

clean_body: | | | Peter – one accusation changed the trajectory of my family's life forever. My great-grandfather courageously stood up for someone who was wrongfully accused of a crime. It was 1959 in South Carolina, and out of revenge, my great-grandfather was murdered. While dealing with the loss of my great-grandfather, my entire family soon came under threat, and so my great-grandmother packed the car and fled to Maryland to find a new home. My great-grandmother had every reason to be bitter and feel hopeless. But I always remember her telling me this story and sharing with me: “If you don’t like something, you go farther and you do better.” I’ve spent my life trying to live up to my great-grandmother’s words. I became a State’s Attorney to seek justice for Maryland families, and I’ve been proudly serving as a county executive to improve the lives of my neighbors. Only in America could three generations separate a woman forced to flee the South, to now me running to become the first Black senator for the great state of Maryland. People like me, stories like mine, don’t often make it to the United States Senate — but they should. | | | I’m running for Senate to ensure that our families feel safe, that our children have a brighter future ahead, and that our fundamental freedoms are protected. But Mitch McConnell personally recruited Larry Hogan (R) to defeat me because he thought it was his best shot at flipping the Senate red. Carilion Clinic vs. Lewis Gale Charity Softball Game - Oct. 1 Henrietta Lacks Statue Unveiling - Oct. 4
Join us for the 6th Annual Carilion Clinic vs. Lewis Gale Charity Softball Game, being held at the Home of the Salem Red Sox - Carilion Clinic Field. A dignified sculpture will commemorate the ongoing and long unrecognized contributions of Roanoke native Henrietta Lacks, who unknowingly provided the world with the HeLa cell, fueling decades of life-saving and life changing research.
Physicians, nurses and administrators will suit up for each hospital during the nine-inning contest. Proceeds will benefit the American Heart Association. Unveiling is October 4th at 11 am at Henrietta Lacks Plaza.
Admission is $5 at the gate, kids under 10 free. Gates open at 1pm and the game starts at 2pm. 410 3rd St SW, Roanoke, VA 24011

Last night, I had the chance to take the stage and tell voters in the Lower Hudson Valley why I’m the right choice to represent our community in Congress.
Team—

I wanted to take a moment to thank all the folks who chipped in to show support before and after last night's debate. _In a race as close as this one, every dollar truly matters, and I'm so grateful to have you on my team._

Last night, I had the chance to take the stage and tell voters in the Lower Hudson Valley why I'm the right choice to represent our community in Congress. It was an opportunity to stand up for the values we care about—lowering costs for working families, fighting for women's rights, and being a champion for our LGBTQ+ neighbors.

You’re receiving this email because of your interest in Pennsylvania Democrats. We need all hands on deck to protect our PA House majority, but if you wish to unsubscribe: https://secure.ngpvan.com/p/19EJj4H6TUuYDFkr8qDPQA2?unsubscribedata=dIs8WWiD4um8CWG5fJ1tbwX9d0Q98Rq2sN5lcrfrRLXClwifBuhiwJZdDz1ZvYLy9naeLQo3s69GM4l4btmqS%2Fe%2FgK9CnEoqfYk6dsib1SG8Aaq3ApVpbLijQTJAa2vqk8TaWBZXesAjONZFISY146y0gvmDShbe%2BaSBNrSdJtN7FhBg8ponnCtcDBM7YG6ReppUQoUToHX%2Bd7w237KPi3jNOlLVkdOwTGTiTTads7KnXu1LRPGP%2FRcfrUJgGZOLydiHDoeMKdTJo6jnMipnXb0mWxyAgytwzokJ%2BjP5%2B%2FFF6pJVvAAvcB%2BO5C9%2F76x6BZ839ib0QoMNfev5bwdkS1K4BopuC%2B404GMFHihKjF7e1uAyR0tydrhkpyn2wA08qQc5NxFe2WvreboMD%2BGbCPICp0lOYTDa8A3kRTudEF8BIzH4sYaj8ZHYVlkAHxOC , you may do so at any time.

Peter,

I’m Joanna McClinton, Speaker of the Pennsylvania House of Representatives and proud to serve the 191st District in Philadelphia.

I am so proud to serve the community that raised me. Growing up in Southwest Philadelphia, I was taught at a young age that when you see injustice, you face it head-on.

From my time as a public defender to my role as a preacher and Speaker of the House, I’ve learned that the best way to deliver results is to listen, and that’s why I’m asking for your response.

Peter, will you take a minute to fill out this survey and let me know what issues you’re most concerned about right now? [https://secure.ngpvan.com/LDeRLkJFOEGbN6j9wPSevQ2?contactdata=/UZHcmewWgndt+0dFEItbXT1gMvsI/Q9NHtximWtk54JHzISEZ1pLLNaD94Pfnu7uxv4RCMVBam3DIhPBqIurG6sNSrPtJqAJkIyhMHIBpQ4dmsvADME86M5+GjQ306bG0/gvNRd4kl/rtFRevuB3FqESUI+1DtUewZQ3tYl7zY=]

For the first time in over a decade, Democrats have control of the Pennsylvania State House, and I’m determined to use our power for good. Rather than focusing on taking away rights and targeting marginalized communities, Pennsylvania House Democrats have and will continue to pass legislation to lead the charge for progress.

But first, I need to know what issues are most important to you. Will you take just a minute to fill out my issues survey and tell me what your priorities are? [http://secure.ngpvan.com/LDeRLkJFOEGbN6j9wPSevQ2?contactdata=/UZHcmewWgndt+0dFEItbXT1gMvsI/Q9NHtximWtk54JHzISEZ1pLLNaD94Pfnu7uxv4RCMVBam3DIhPBqIurG6sNSrPtJqAJkIyhMHIBpQ4dmsvADME86M5+GjQ306bG0/gvNRd4kl/rtFRevuB3FqESUI+1DtUewZQ3tYl7zY=]

ISSUES SURVEY → [https://secure.ngpvan.com/LDeRLkJFOEGbN6j9wPSevQ2?contactdata=/UZHcmewWgndt+0dFEItbXT1gMvsI/Q9NHtximWtk54JHzISEZ1pLLNaD94Pfnu7uxv4RCMVBam3DIhPBqIurG6sNSrPtJqAJkIyhMHIBpQ4dmsvADME86M5+GjQ306bG0/gvNRd4kl/rtFRevuB3FqESUI+1DtUewZQ3tYl7zY=]

When we elect people who understand the importance of listening to the communities they represent, we can achieve real progress.

I look forward to hearing from you!

Thank you,

Speaker Joanna McClinton

Joanna McClinton serves as the Speaker of the Pennsylvania State House, while proudly serving the 191st district.
Joanna has made important strides to enact progress in the Pennsylvania Legislature. | | The stakes are huge in this election, but you've probably heard that before. Here's what it actually looks like: **The biggest expansion of Medicare in years**. Kamala Harris' proposal to cover long-term home care means our parents and grandparents can stay in their homes longer and receive care from home health aides. This one proposal will change the game for every person who's wondering what their options are for their aging loved ones, especially those who are trying to balance caring for small children at the same time. **Help for first-time homebuyers**. Affordable housing seems to be at an all-time low right now. One way to fight back for younger people is to substantially increase the support they receive to buy their first homes and begin building wealth. Harris will raise this tax credit to $25,000 for new homebuyers ready to take the leap. **Affordable childcare**. Harris has proposed capping childcare-related expenses to just 7% of household income at a time when the Department of Labor says childcare costs range from 8% to nearly 20% of median household income. Parents will be able to return to work when they're ready and send their kids to high-quality care during the day. **Support for innovators**. New small businesses can benefit from extra support in the form of raising the small business tax credit to $25,000 to invest in American innovation, create jobs, and let savvy entrepreneurs build the next great American company. These are policies that put money back into the pockets of the working class, invest in our people and our country, and give families what they need to thrive. **We can do big things in this country when there are two competent, caring leaders at the top of the ticket. When Americans go to the polls soon – and some already are! – they're thinking of the big picture and long-term. 19 days to go – let's vote for a new future!** _Sarah_ Sarah Long
Director of Development

This week on the debate stage, I told Ted Cruz directly to his face that he was a threat to democracy for inciting the mob that overtook our Capitol on January 6.
And what was his response? He laughed!!
There's nothing funny about this, y'all.
I was on the House floor on January 6 when rioters breached the Capitol.
First, I heard the glass break. Then, as they pounded on the doors, I texted my wife Aly, who was seven months pregnant with our second son: "Whatever happens, I love you."
I took off my jacket and got ready to fight anyone who came through the door. Thankfully, it never came to that.
But while I was barricaded on the House floor with my colleagues with our gas masks in hand, Ted Cruz – who had cheered on the mob earlier that day – hid in a supply closet .
In just 19 days, we have the chance to replace Ted Cruz and give Texans the Senator we deserve.
But after this week’s debate, a fresh wave of GOP spending is pouring into Texas to crush our momentum in this final push. And the latest polling still shows this race locked neck and neck.
There's no doubt in my mind that we can win this race and finally hold Ted Cruz accountable – but ONLY if we have the resources to do it. So please, will you split a donation between me and Tim Kaine now to fuel our grassroots movement to victory and defeat Ted Cruz once and for all?
