body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
Friends,
Last Tuesday, I sat on stage with my opponent, Bill Wells, for a candidate forum. The goal of this forum was for each of us to share our views and priorities with San Diego voters.
And let me tell you, it was beyond disturbing to hear him use the 90 minutes of that forum to repeatedly demonize immigrants with far-right xenophobic rhetoric.
At one point he even seemed to say that he only wants white immigrants in this country. (Seriously.)
Let’s be clear: This kind of xenophobic rhetoric doesn’t make any of us safer. It’s harmful and divisive, and it’s not going to solve any of the important issues we need to address in San Diego or across the country.
So many of the people stoking fear around immigrants and asylum seekers seem to forget that our current asylum laws were created in the aftermath of the Holocaust, when Jews were denied the refuge they desperately needed.
The values of compassion and justice are the foundation of who we are as a country. People who want to be leaders in our federal government should NOT be demonizing those who are fleeing violence and persecution and seeking safety in America.
Look, through my first two terms in Congress, I’ve heard directly from Customs and Border Protection and those directly working on the issue every day. I visit the border at least once a quarter, and every person I’ve talked to has made it 100% clear that the best way to address our immigration challenges is to create more and faster legal pathways to citizenship.
I’m proud to fight for a compassionate and fact-based approach to immigration in Congress, and I’m asking for your support to keep doing this critical work.
Will you make a contribution to my re-election campaign today to stand against the dangerous rhetoric my opponent is spreading and make sure we defeat him in November? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]
Thank you for standing with me on this.
-Sara

clean_body: [] Friends, Last Tuesday, I sat on stage with my opponent, Bill Wells, for a candidate forum. The goal of this forum was for each of us to share our views and priorities with San Diego voters. And let me tell you, it was beyond disturbing to hear him use the 90 minutes of that forum to repeatedly demonize immigrants with far-right xenophobic rhetoric. At one point he even seemed to say that he only wants white immigrants in this country. (Seriously.) Let’s be clear: This kind of xenophobic rhetoric doesn’t make any of us safer. It’s harmful and divisive, and it’s not going to solve any of the important issues we need to address in San Diego or across the country. So many of the people stoking fear around immigrants and asylum seekers seem to forget that our current asylum laws were created in the aftermath of the Holocaust, when Jews were denied the refuge they desperately needed. The values of compassion and justice are the foundation of who we are as a country. People who want to be leaders in our federal government should NOT be demonizing those who are fleeing violence and persecution and seeking safety in America. Look, through my first two terms in Congress, I’ve heard directly from Customs and Border Protection and those directly working on the issue every day. I visit the border at least once a quarter, and every person I’ve talked to has made it 100% clear that the best way to address our immigration challenges is to create more and faster legal pathways to citizenship. I’m proud to fight for a compassionate and fact-based approach to immigration in Congress, and I’m asking for your support to keep doing this critical work. Will you make a contribution to my re-election campaign today to stand against the dangerous rhetoric my opponent is spreading and make sure we defeat him in November? body:
This is why we have to beat Ted Cruz on November 5.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95229992/506031565/107218408?refcode=email_101724_allreddeluziosplit&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU0MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlYzM3NGM2My1hOThjLWVmMTEtODQ3NC0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=yqOCSf_chBvn5gxKoGkQdYxfylVf_TFOy0DvkknTEnA=) Derek, this week on the debate stage, I told Ted Cruz directly to his face that he was a threat to democracy for inciting the mob that overtook our Capitol on January 6.

And what was his response? _He laughed!!_

There's nothing funny about this, Derek.

I was on the House floor on January 6 when rioters breached the Capitol.

First, I heard the glass break. **Then, as they pounded on the doors, I texted my wife Aly, who was seven months pregnant with our second son:_"Whatever happens, I love you."_**

I took off my jacket and got ready to fight anyone who came through the door. Thankfully, it never came to that.

**But while I was barricaded on the House floor with my colleagues with our gas masks in hand, Ted Cruz – who had cheered on the mob earlier that day – _hid in a supply closet._**

In just 19 days, we have the chance to replace Ted Cruz and give Texans the Senator we deserve.

But after this week’s debate, a fresh wave of GOP spending is pouring into Texas to crush our momentum in this final push. And the latest polling still shows this race locked neck and neck.

**There's no doubt in my mind that we can win this race and finally hold Ted Cruz accountable – but ONLY if we have the resources to do it.[So please, will you split a donation between me and Rep. body:
I know how it goes. You chip in to one political campaign, and suddenly it seems like every Democratic candidate in America has your email address and needs $5 before the end of the day. It’s a lot. I get it.

But something about this message caught your eye and you opened it. So I will be quick and make my pitch before you delete.

Will you chip in to help fund my campaign today? [https://secure.ngpvan.com/s_RYM4EIQE2o2CKKg7zbig2?am=35&contactdata=as6wxwL0VeQHPpBdjC/r/afPRzW17f/63wJilx2wgld0m/jEMvw9KdyisOSQJls9xV/ikOgiNCzwQ2FNyuR7hLgQ3+HHEgNT1wDoGTQMbjveNtRZfuySLzJzZU6b/Lr0ZNHGPqUN82nAZTMWozsZwlZK+b1w2miaZwHxbpi4VeM=]

I’m proud to be supported by grassroots activists who want pragmatic, sensible leaders to fight for our freedoms and deliver common-sense solutions. That’s the kind of leadership I’ve worked to provide every day in Congress and that’s why I’m running for re-election.

Unfortunately there could not be a more stark contrast between me and my opponent. I am running against a MAGA supporter who wants to restrict women’s reproductive rights and roll back the other progresses we’ve made.

You know what’s at stake here, and why it’s so important to run a strong campaign. That’s why I need your support today.

Please chip in and donate $15 or whatever you can afford so we can get our message out and win this November! Sincerely,
Saud Carbajal

Yesterday, Vice President Kamala Harris sat down for an interview with _Fox News_ ' Bret Baier, often praised by legacy media as a serious journalist.

He leaned heavily on far-right talking points, focusing on scare tactics like immigration and transgender rights, echoing Donald Trump. At one point, Baier even played a Trump campaign ad, further amplifying Trump’s message.

Instead of showing the actual clip where Trump made the alarming statement, they aired an unrelated video of him falsely accusing his opponents of weaponizing the legal system against him.**

And unlike Trump, who often demeans reporters he doesn’t like with insults like "nasty," Harris maintained her composure, showing dignity throughout.

1. What are your top two environmental priorities, and what steps do you plan to take to address them?
2. What does 'environmental justice' mean to you? And how will your understanding of environmental justice impact your priorities if elected?

clean_body: Unless we organize like never before, the billions that corporate elites are pouring into Pennsylvania could tip the scales in Trump’s favor. | | | Pennsylvania is the biggest battleground of 2024, Peter — and right-wing billionaires are circling it like vultures. Yesterday, Elon Musk announced he’ll be holding a series of talks across the state every night this week.1 This announcement comes just weeks after his first rally with Donald Trump, where he literally jumped for joy on stage in Butler, Pennsylvania, proudly calling himself “dark MAGA.”2 But that’s not all. Musk's America PAC just filed its latest FEC report, revealing that he’s poured an eye-popping $75 million into Trump’s campaign over just the last three months.3 With your $10 contribution, we can: 📚 Print 32 pieces of literature 📞 Make 29 calls to voters 🚀 Boost canvassing and staff capacity 🌟 Elect Kamala Harris and Working Families Party champions up and down the ballot in Pennsylvania and other swing states. Meanwhile, Musk has also turned Twitter — now rebranded as X — into a pro-MAGA misinformation machine.4 Despite the platform losing 80% of its value since he bought it for $44 billion,5 Musk is willing to take that hit, hoping that his real payout will come if Trump and insurrectionist Republicans regain full control of the levers of powers in D.C. And Musk isn’t the only one bankrolling Republicans in Pennsylvania this election. 2024’s largest election donor Jeffrey Yass and other billionaire elites are funneling mountains of cash to prop up their corporate, anti-union, special interest agenda. But that’s where the Working Families Party comes in. We’re on the ground in Pennsylvania and key battleground states across the country, pushing back with people power. We’re organizing not just for Harris and Walz, but also for key champions like Senator Bob Casey, Malcolm Kenyatta , Eugene DePasquale, and Rep. Summer Lee — all fighting for working families. And every district and state we can win for these candidates will help Kamala Harris win on Election Day. Peter, we may not have the billions of our opponents — but we can out-organize them at the doors, on the phones, and through real conversations with voters. In solidarity, Working Families Party Sources: 1\. So why did NBC News release an article trumpeting a video from Voters Of Tomorrow attacking Jill, perfectly timed to coincide with its launch? It seems odd that NBC would amplify the voice of such an obscure group and was ready to promote their smear as soon as it came out.

| Peter, I’ve always said, _working hard is not enough when you’re not earning enough_.

**It’s been 18 years since North Carolina last raised the minimum wage.** Back in 2006, we fought tooth and nail just to increase it by one dollar. That’s right— _a whole decade of fighting for a $1 raise._

While workers in other states have seen their wages rise over time, North Carolinians are still stuck at the federal minimum wage, despite the rising cost of living.

_**I fought and sponsored the 2006 minimum wage increase, and I still continue to fight for fair wages in Congress.**_

I’ve spent my career standing up for workers, but we won’t see real progress unless we elect leaders who believe in fair wages. The stakes couldn’t be higher, and I need your help to keep fighting.

That’s right—a whole decade of fighting for a $1 raise. | = | Peter, I’ve always said, working hard is not enough when you’re not earning enough. It’s been 18 years since North Carolina last raised the minimum wage. Back in 2006, we fought tooth and nail just to increase it by one dollar. That’s right— a whole decade of fighting for a $1 raise. While workers in other states have seen their wages rise over time, North Carolinians are still stuck at the federal minimum wage, despite the rising cost of living. I fought and sponsored the 2006 minimum wage increase, and I still continue to fight for fair wages in Congress. I’ve spent my career standing up for workers, but we won’t see real progress unless we elect leaders who believe in fair wages. subject: Do you have a few hours this week, Derek?
body:

Derek -- we’ll be direct: Giving just a few hours of your time could be the difference in preventing a Trump presidency. body:
The John Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act is groundbreaking federal legislation that will protect the rights of millions of voters across the country. That's why President Biden called for Congress to act on this bill during his annual State of the Union speech.
With what we've seen over the past few years in Texas, in Florida, in John Lewis' own beloved state of Georgia, and beyond -- we need to do EVERYTHING in our power to make sure this law gets signed into law.
We can't do that alone, we need your grassroots pressure on Congress to make it happen. Pitch in $25 or whatever you can today to fight back against the vote suppressors in Congress and make this bill a law >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=101724_2&amount=25]
Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=101724_2&amount=25]
BCJ: Pass the John R. Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=101724_2&amount=25]
Team: The landmark John R. Lewis Voting Rights Advancement has been stuck in the U.S. House of Representatives since last fall. We need your help to get it moving again.
After ten long years of attacks on voting rights, from the 2013 Supreme Court decision in Shelby County v. Holder to the voter suppression bills that swept over our country since the 2020 election, this legislation is a ray of light beaming out from a dark landscape.
This bill would undo the damage done by the Supreme Court and create a Voting Rights Act for the 21st century. It would restore preclearance in states that are discriminating on the basis of race and create preclearance for certain practices that are frequently discriminatory. It would also bolster Section 2 of the original Voting Rights Act, which allows lawsuits to ensure voters of color have the opportunity for fair representation. I n short, this bill would right a lot of wrongs in our democracy.
Team: We need to fight for this bill no matter who controls Congress. Pitch in $25 or whatever you can today to defend the right to vote and support our work to pass this critical legislation >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=101724_2&amount=25]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:

The original Voting Rights Act is one of the most important laws ever passed in American history and a critical protection against discrimination in our democracy. With the Supreme Court dismantling it piece by piece, we need the John Lewis Voting Rights Act to restore our right to vote.
The nonpartisan Brennan Center for Justice has called the current assault on voting rights "staggering" . According to their accounting, " At least 19 states passed 33 laws in 2021 making it harder to vote. Many of these laws target voters of color, exacerbating persistent racial disparities in access. Turnout for nonwhite voters is now substantially lower than that for white voters — and has been for at least 25 years. Despite record voter turnout in 2020, only 58 percent of nonwhite voters participated, compared to 71 percent of white voters. "
Congress has the power to solve the voting rights crisis . It's up to us to make sure they do their jobs.
Help hold them accountable, Team: Congress needs to pass the John Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act immediately. Chip in $25 or whatever you can right now to help make it happen >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=101724_2&amount=25]

name: Evangelicals for Harris
subject: Be Encouraged. Vote. Share. Pray.
body:
Vote. Share Your Story. | |
---
| | | Sometimes it’s encouraging to know we’re not alone, so we wanted to share with you that our [Evangelicals for Harris](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=3403702631&e=43463f1dee) community is now over 300,000. Our [X/Twitter feed](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=0aa9a70f86&e=43463f1dee) has over 30,000 followers and our ads have garnered **[over 50 million views](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=75ad406f6f&e=43463f1dee)**.

Together, we’re reaching millions with a positive message of Christian values of love of neighbor and compassion for the less fortunate that are driving support for Harris and Walz. Thank you for helping make all this possible.

**Vote**. With early voting already begun, **it’s now time to cast our votes for the future we’re hoping for by voting for Vice President Harris and Governor Walz.** If you haven’t already voted, vote early. See our [**voting resources page**](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=bc2b00aa36&e=43463f1dee) to help you make your plan.

**Share. Share your support for Harris and Walz with your networks, families and friends. Your encouragement and influence help encourage others to support Harris and Walz. **You might:
* Take a picture of yourself voting and share on your social media (e.g. wearing or displaying Evangelicals for Harris [memorabilia](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=8825513c2c&e=43463f1dee));
* Tag colleagues, family and friends in your social posts, especially those in battleground states (Pennylvania, Michigan, Wisconsin, Georgia, North Carolina, Nevada, Arizona, and Nebraska);
* Post a Harris-Walz yard sign;
* Help others make their plan by sharing our [voting resources page](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=4453320798&e=43463f1dee), offering to help them with their plan, and offering help where you can – e.g., watching the kids, a ride to the polls, casting their mail-in ballot;
* Watch and share our Evangelicals for Harris [ads](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=76faaf2408&e=43463f1dee) and our [women’s call highlights](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=fc724414f7&e=43463f1dee).

**Pray. There’s much to pray for with this election. Here are some options:**
* That love for others, especially the less fortunate and the vulnerable, is what determines our votes;
* Wisdom for all voters to see what’s best for the country;
* That voters take their gift of citizenship seriously, producing a strong turnout;
* A decisive victory for Vice President Harris and Gov. Walz.

**If you want to do more, especially in battleground states, please fill out this [google form](https://themaidengroup.us10.list-manage.com/track/click?u=417baae6ed2ee4b374c9c9805&id=882ecb73c3&e=43463f1dee). ** We’ll be in touch.

This election is a spiritual _kairos_ moment – an appointed moment to act in faith for God’s kingdom. This election will determine the future of our country and communities. Thank you for all you’re doing to create a better future through your support of Harris and Walz. We’re praying for you.

Blessings,
The Evangelicals for Harris Team

I’m writing to you with a sense of urgency about Pennsylvania’s Senate race, where Senator Bob Casey is in a dead heat with Connecticut mega-millionaire David McCormick.
This race is one of the most competitive in the country. The polls are tightening, and to put an even bigger emphasis on Pennsylvania, the control of the Senate could come down to this race.

name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: I want you to meet someone . . .
body:
Dear Peter,

The Abortion Lobby is throwing everything it’s got into the upcoming election.

They’ve got millions of taxpayer dollars to cushion their efforts . . .

They have the media, academia, Big Tech, Hollywood, and many in the corporate world on their side.

So, you and I are no match for them . . . right?

https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/1KBvlQPq7D6sM-D5b3YIGw~~/AAVkMwA~/RgRo8--xY85SFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA
Of course, that’s what the Abortion Lobby wants us to believe. But they couldn’t be more wrong.

You see, you and I have the TRUTH on our side.

And thousands of passionate young people just like Maria Thomas (pictured here) who dedicate their time to defend preborn lives!

So, will you please agree to help keep Maria and our other canvassers knocking on doors in key Battleground and Referendum States through Election Day
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/1jxr9e9xOR6nN7C2Mrx9sA~~/AAVkMwA~/RgRo8--xY85SFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA
?

Maria is currently a sophomore at Indiana University in Bloomington, Indiana.

And she’s currently volunteering for us by helping to knock on doors in Michigan.

In case you were wondering how it was going, Maria told me:

“I was blown away by how positive the response was. So many people not only affirmed their own pro-life beliefs but also expressed how encouraged they were to see young pro-lifers out in the community!”

The truth is, our team of Pro-Life Student Canvassers are the backbone of our 2024 efforts.

We know the best way to change hearts and minds – and convert Pro-Life First voters – is with one-on-one conversations. I mean, we do it every day on campuses.

And I know that not only are these conversations critical to converting voters and driving pro-life turnout in November, but they’re also shifting the larger cultural battle – one we cannot ignore if we want to make abortion illegal and unthinkable.

Thankfully, Students for Life Action is hard at work with several volunteer deployments already completed across the country!

We just wrapped up successful door knocking in North Carolina, New Hampshire, Michigan,Montana, Nebraska, Arizona, but we’ll also be in key battleground districts in just a few days in:

● Florida
● Missouri
● Oklahoma
● Pennsylvania

It’s so crucial that we support our volunteer canvassers the best we can.

These young men and women like Maria are on the front lines every day putting in late nights of driving or making calls, having doors slammed in their faces, and even being harassed and attacked by pro-abortion radicals.

And they do it willingly! All to find the voters who are receptive to our message.

That’s why your contribution of even just $25 for a hot pizza that our canvassers can enjoy after a long day would be greatly appreciated
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/pN55aV4Au5FVpXfnSN4LXg~~/AAVkMwA~/RgRo8--xY85SFGRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tWAQAAAAA
.

But what I’d really like to do is send them a whole care package to keep them going.

Something that says, “Thanks for all your hard work, and God bless you!”

A
Care Package Gift of $100
https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/O2MKcTn1EArpGcHlMu6QaA~~/AAVkMwA~/RgRo8-P1P4Q_~
can provide the door knocking materials they need, like Students for Life Action shirts, flyers, postcards, markers, and more!

name: No Dem Left Behind
subject: Across the Country: October 17th, 2024
body:
Georgia is on pace to set records for early voting turnout!
| | | | | |
---
**_Across the Country_**
---
|
---
Hello, folks! Welcome back to _Across the Country_ , our weekly series dedicated to amplifying the voices of our communities as we approach the pivotal 2024 election. The stakes are high, and the energy in Georgia is electric! –Daniela Rodriguez
---
| | | | **Georgia**
---
|
---
Early voting kicked off in Georgia on October 15th, and we're already seeing record-breaking turnout. On the first day alone, over **300,000 ballots** were cast—three times the turnout compared to 2020! Georgians are determined to make their voices heard, with the left leaning Metro Atlanta area having high turnout as well. As a crucial battleground state, Georgia holds the keys to shaping the future of our democracy. Remember when Trump told the Georgia Secretary of State, “Find me 11,780 votes.” WE ARE NOT GOING BACK! Our individual votes are sacred—and we will not have it questioned or tested.
---
|
---
**Mobilizing Young Voters** This election, it’s crucial that we mobilize young voters. Historically, Democrats and independents have led the way in early voting, and recent NBC polls show that over **50% of Georgia voters** plan to cast their ballots early this year. This is our moment to harness that enthusiasm and ensure every voter is mobilized. Young voters have the power to drive change, and Georgia's future is in their hands. Let’s rally together, share our stories, and encourage our friends and families to participate. Every vote counts!
---
|
---
**Transportation to the Polls** And to make sure you can get to your polling place on November 5th, we have a special discount for you! Use the Lyft code **VOTE24** to arrive on time and ready to make a difference. Let’s keep this momentum going, Georgia! Your vote is your voice—make sure it's heard.
---
|
---
-Daniela Rodriguez

Election Day is just 18 days away, and we don’t have a moment to waste. Because the latest polls show Kamala Harris and Donald Trump in a statistical tie. In a toss-up election (and remember, four of the last six presidential elections in Wisconsin have come down to less than 1%), the victory often goes to the side that works harder. We call it the margin of effort. That’s why we need to pull out all the stops right now. The only way we win in November is if we get every Democratic voter to the polls. Republicans are pouring millions into this race, flooding the airwaves with attack ads, and doing everything they can to flip our state red. If we don’t fight back now, they could tip the scales in their favor. We can’t let that happen. That’s why we’re racing to raise $15,000 before midnight tonight to give us the resources we need to WIN on Election Day. [But I need your help: Can you chip in $10 right now to the Democratic Party of Wisconsin?](https://default.salsalabs.org/Td823ce1d-51a4-46ac-be97-408cddd34f3d/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| | | Experts agree that Wisconsin could be the tipping point state. But this isn’t isn’t just about winning — it’s about protecting our democracy. Because if Donald Trump and the MAGA Republicans take control, we could risk losing everything.
* Voting Rights
* Social Security
* LGBTQ+ Equality
* Reproductive Freedom
* And so much more...

Like Kamala Harris says, we are not going back. Not with so much at stake for Wisconsin and for our country. But with the race this close, we need all hands on deck to win in November. Every dollar donated will go toward our critical work of turning out voters, countering Republican attacks, and keeping Wisconsin blue. But we need to hit our $15,000 goal to keep our operations going through Election Day. We can’t do this without you. With just 18 days left, your support could be the difference between victory and defeat. [So will you chip in $10 right now to fuel our fight?](https://default.salsalabs.org/T6d60d333-c77b-48fc-b5e5-b64688b3cc08/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

We fight for these values every day. Speaking up on our platforms, raising the voices and the political prospects of liberal pols and pundits. body:
**Breaking News: Congressman Raja Krishnamoorthi was just endorsed for re-election by the Chicago Tribune!**

The Tribune's Editorial Board wrote: "Krishnamoorthi, who is seeking his fifth term, told us that what matters most to his constituents is 'the ability for themselves and their family to achieve economic freedom and access to the middle class, which includes ensuring that Medicare and Social Security are solvent in order to secure their future,'" and that Congressman Raja "believes education is the key to class mobility."

They concluded by explaining that their choice "remains Krishnamoorthi, 51, a smart and intellectually sophisticated member of the House Intelligence Committee and a rising figure in national politics whom we have previously endorsed," further explaining that they "find the incumbent a detail-oriented representative known for stellar service to his constituents and very much in tune with this nation’s problems and assets."

Please share this endorsement with your friends and family, and let’s get out the vote for Congressman Raja on or before November 5th!

Arizona is voting. We don’t know how they’re voting, but we do know where they’re voting and what party they belong to.
#

Peter, we’re getting data every day about how ballot returns (whether that’s early voting or folks mailing in their ballots) are shaping up in Arizona.
Arizona is voting. We don’t know how they’re voting, but we do know where they’re voting and what party they belong to.
Take a quick look at this chart. It’s going to seem confusing at first, but we’ll break it down for you.

But the thing we really want you to key in on is that **Democratic ballot returns are trailing Republican ballot returns SIGNIFICANTLY.** We’re way behind where we were in 2020, AND we’re way behind where the Republicans are right now.
This keeps us up at night. If it continues this way, we’re going to have real trouble catching back up. But there are two things that give us a little bit of reassurance:

Dear Friend,

**Mary Peltola's lies have gotten so bad, the mainstream press is starting to take notice.**

The lies are so blatant that honest reporters have no choice but to call it out. If we’re going to win this, we need [your financial support](https://alaskansfornickbegich.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8aeb8c45837a089b0eee9add8&id=7c1000861e&e=6679001ba0) to push back against Peltola’s smear campaign and get our message out there. Let’s show them we won’t ever back down.

Nick Begich

body:

---
I need your eyes on this ASAP, friend,

This is why we have to beat Ted Cruz on November 5.
#

Hey everybody, it’s Mark Kelly. My friend Colin Allred is running for election to the Senate in 2024, and we’re working to support him. I hope you’ll read the message below from him, and [**consider splitting a donation between Colin's campaign and mine.**](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-allred.-4YRZz&refcode=em241017-1-90&t=1&akid=5899%2E6688874%2Exm9VmY)

---
Friend, this week on the debate stage, I told Ted Cruz directly to his face that he was a threat to democracy for inciting the mob that overtook our Capitol on January 6.
And what was his response? _He laughed!!_
There's nothing funny about this.
I was on the House floor on January 6 when rioters breached the Capitol.
First, I heard the glass break. **Then, as they pounded on the doors, I texted my wife Aly, who was seven months pregnant with our second son:_"Whatever happens, I love you."_**
I took off my jacket and got ready to fight anyone who came through the door. Thankfully, it never came to that.
**But while I was barricaded on the House floor with my colleagues with our gas masks in hand, Ted Cruz – who had cheered on the mob earlier that day – _hid in a supply closet._ **
In just 18 days, we have the chance to replace Ted Cruz and give Texans the Senator we deserve.
But after this week’s debate, a fresh wave of GOP spending is pouring into Texas to crush our momentum in this final push. And the latest polling still shows this race locked neck and neck.
**There's no doubt in my mind that we can win this race and finally hold Ted Cruz accountable – but ONLY if we have the resources to do it.[So please, will you split a donation between me and Mark Kelly now to fuel our grassroots movement to victory and defeat Ted Cruz once and for all? Any amount you can spare will make a difference in these make-or-break final weeks. **](https://act.markkelly.com/go/1389?c0=mek-em-allred.-4YRZz&refcode=em241017-1-90&t=3&akid=5899%2E6688874%2Exm9VmY)

| | Hi Peter — With Election Day less than three weeks away, I can only assume your inbox is full of requests from campaigns like mine trying to earn your support. _That’s how my inbox looks!_ Chances are, you didn’t wake up this morning thinking,_“today’s the day I’m going to donate to Tammy’s reelection campaign!”_ But I hope you’ll give me a moment to explain why you should. My Republican opponent, Eric Hovde, and right-wing super PACs have engaged in a massive ad blitz to tear me down and flip my seat red — **they’ve already spent $71 million on the airwaves,** and there’s more where that came from. A national abortion ban, cuts to Social Security and Medicare, a repeal of the Affordable Care Act, and so much more will be on the table if Republicans flip this seat red. And trust me when I tell you, Peter,_they sure think that they can._ It’s why Mitch McConnell’s super PAC just dropped $24 million worth of ads in Wisconsin — **they wouldn’t spend that kind of money this close to the election unless they were confident Hovde could win.** With consecutive polls showing a tightening statistically-tied race and elections experts moving our race to a “Toss Up,” it’s more urgent than ever before that we respond to the Republican attacks I’m facing with ads of our own to set the record straight. But these ad reservations don’t come cheap, and I don’t have the same luxury of dipping into a personal fortune to fund this campaign like my megamillionaire opponent can. That’s why I’m counting on your grassroots support today. **[So, Peter, can I count on you to split a donation of $10 or more between my campaign and Gwen Moore to help us fight back against Hovde, McConnell, and the right-wing super PACs trying to buy Wisconsin’s Senate seat? That’s how my inbox looks! Chances are, you didn’t wake up this morning thinking,“today’s the day I’m going to donate to Tammy’s reelection campaign!” But I hope you’ll give me a moment to explain why you should. My Republican opponent, Eric Hovde, and right-wing super PACs have engaged in a massive ad blitz to tear me down and flip my seat red — they’ve already spent $71 million on the airwaves, and there’s more where that came from. A national abortion ban, cuts to Social Security and Medicare, a repeal of the Affordable Care Act, and so much more will be on the table if Republicans flip this seat red. And trust me when I tell you, Peter,they sure think that they can. It’s why Mitch McConnell’s super PAC just dropped $24 million worth of ads in Wisconsin — they wouldn’t spend that kind of money this close to the election unless they were confident Hovde could win. With consecutive polls showing a tightening statistically-tied race and elections experts moving our race to a “Toss Up,” it’s more urgent than ever before that we respond to the Republican attacks I’m facing with ads of our own to set the record straight. But these ad reservations don’t come cheap, and I don’t have the same luxury of dipping into a personal fortune to fund this campaign like my megamillionaire opponent can. Team, It’s been five years since Trump made the corrupt phone call that forever altered the lives of me and my twin brother.On July 25, 2019, my brother Alexander Vindman listened as President Trump attempted to extort our ally Ukraine, a country at war, by withholding military aid unless President Zelenskyy investigated Joe Biden. At the time, I was serving as the senior ethics official at the National Security Council in the White House. subject: Donald Trump’s message to grieving parents of school shooting victims:
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
We are infuriated
#

At a Univision town hall last night, Donald Trump was asked, “Could you explain your gun control policy to the parents of the victims of school shootings?”
Trump’s response?
**_He said he would tell grieving parents: “You wouldn't be able to take away the guns because people need that for security, they need it for entertainment and for sports and other things.”_**
We are infuriated.
Gun violence is the NUMBER ONE killer of children and teens in America. This year, we’ve already surpassed the number of school shootings we had in 2023.
When our children are getting shot dead in schools, people’s “entertainment” cannot come before enacting commonsense gun safety legislation.
Trump’s comments make it even more crystal clear that he will not do anything to solve our nation’s gun violence crisis. His loyalties lie with the gun lobby, and if we let him take back the White House this November, all of the progress we’ve made in our gun violence prevention movement will be in jeopardy.
[**We must elect Vice President Kamala Harris and Governor Tim Walz to keep moving forward in our work to end gun violence. Peter, this week on the debate stage, I told Ted Cruz directly to his face that he was a threat to democracy for inciting the mob that overtook our Capitol on January 6.
And what was his response? _He laughed!!_
There's nothing funny about this, Peter.
I was on the House floor on January 6 when rioters breached the Capitol.
First, I heard the glass break. **Then, as they pounded on the doors, I texted my wife Aly, who was seven months pregnant with our second son:_"Whatever happens, I love you."_**
I took off my jacket and got ready to fight anyone who came through the door. Thankfully, it never came to that.
**But while I was barricaded on the House floor with my colleagues with our gas masks in hand, Ted Cruz – who had cheered on the mob earlier that day – _hid in a supply closet._**
In just 19 days, we have the chance to replace Ted Cruz and give Texans the Senator we deserve.

subject: Get involved with One PA - Volunteer today!
body:
logo [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/AV/AV001/1/66197/images/OnePA_Logo_FullColor.jpg]
Hello Peter,
We're 18 days out from the election and we need your help to win!
Whether you are in here in Pennsylvania or live in California, we have an opportunity for you to get involved! If you see a volunteer activity you're interested in, please sign up using the Mobilize link for that event.
VIRTUAL VOLUNTEER OPPORTUNITIES
Voter ID Volunteer Phone Bank [https://www.mobilize.us/onepa/event/720249/]
Kickoff on Thursday 10/17, 3:00pm-8pm EST
Tuesdays and Thursday 10/15-10/29, 4:00pm-8pm EST
Join One PA in calling voters to confirm votes for Kamala Harris! This is a partisan, c4 opportunity.
GOTV Volunteer Phone Bank - What's Your Plan to Vote? [https://www.mobilize.us/onepa/event/730151/]
Everyday 10/29-11/4, 4:00pm-7:00pm EST
We want to make sure everyone in Pennsylvania has a plan to vote in this election. Join us for a GOTV phone bank to help our neighbors make a voting plan!
IN-PERSON VOLUNTEER OPPORTUNITIES
Voter Registration Volunteer Canvass [https://www.mobilize.us/onepa/event/720839/]
Wednesday 10/16 4:00-7:00pm EST
Friday 10/18 4:00-7:00pm EST
Saturday 10/19, 11:00am-4:00pm EST
Sunday 10/20, 11:00am-4:00pm EST
Monday 10/21, 11:00am-3:00pm EST and 4:00pm-7:00pm EST
Join us for a volunteer door canvass to get voters registered!
Vote Tripling in Philly! [https://www.mobilize.us/onepa/event/718243/]
Kickoff starts Tuesday 10/22 10:00am-4:00pm EST
Monday - Sunday through 11/4, 10:00am-4:00pm EST (shift lengths will vary!)
Help us triple the vote in Philly!
Join us at the Philly Satellite Election offices for Vote Tripling- Volunteers will be stationed at an assigned satellite election office to ask voters to text 5 of their friends to vote right now!
Election Day Vote Tripling at the Polls [https://www.mobilize.us/onepa/event/718243/]
Tuesday 11/5, 8:00am-8:00pm EST (shift lengths will vary!)
Are you ready to Get Out The Vote this election day?
Join One PA at the polls for Vote Tripling- Volunteers will be stationed at an assigned polling location to ask voters to text 5 of their friends to vote right now!
We hope you'll join us!
In solidarity,
El Nicol, Volunteer Coordinator at One PA

| | Peter, We've been saying it all year - the radical left is **ALL IN** to defeat me and flip Texas blue.

Peter,
We’re sure you’re getting a lot of emails these days, including these ones from your old friends at VoteVets 👋

We’re putting everything we’ve got into winning this election. We are pouring every dollar we’ve saved up over the last four years and everything we raise over the next three weeks into it.

Tuesday we announced another:
* $110,000 in the VA-2 congressional race, another $350,000 in NY-18, another $500,000 in WI-3, and another $725,000 in CA-45.

We reach out so often because donations from folks like you are one of the main ways we fund these campaigns. We work around the clock to make sure we put your donations behind campaigns and candidates that not only can win — but will make us proud.
You’re a critical part of making that happen, Peter.

body:

Do you ever despair that Jesus will never return?

---
Hello Friend,

Despite court rulings in Louisiana and Oklahoma that make the teaching of the Bible and the 10 Commandments mandatory in public schools and universities, we still live in a time when the foundational teachings of the Ten Commandments are no longer emphasized in our public schools and daily lives. As a result, our children are growing up without these essential, God-honoring rules for living.

In this culture of moral confusion, the Ten Commandments provide clear, simple answers about what it means to live a righteous life. Teaching these commandments to children not only instills a sense of security and purpose but also fosters emotional resilience, intellectual acuity, and ethical integrity. The Ten Commandments uphold traditional values and celebrate the family unit as foundational to society, helping children navigate life's challenges with confidence and grace.
---
| | That's why I'm excited to introduce my brand new kids book, _The 10 Commandments for Kids_ book. This book offers kids ten Bible lessons about God's simple rules for living, with each chapter explaining one commandment, discussion questions, applications, and prayers to say together. It's a trustworthy resource for children to read on their own, during church services, or as part of vacation Bible school studies.
---
| [](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=cd7aa592e3e24f54bcbd54a7c18ed084&_e=6RPgqGaUSBI8I6pHkxV__QKzvNe1ScEZZZEgWeI19ddxCpwSZTjatCboR-4iCZRUjG09Z1xDCKqUD3OHc-_bhX3O49vO2r6I9NmD7HOXFO2fbQbUm9Fhk_O36UrF2so_RYWnU7OOs1QdUvhL8BvjUF1UeazvZTlkkO11oTO8XGUX4SoOpTqOEu1CV2ehjCtrc8KDqsCFQ4xtEMjGGs9pTubeX7l96DCj9I1XWztdJQKziwvuJ9VIOR6vXJFb6HQuOCY-hXc5lGRvY9lq0K0Xd8OCvDBZGoWHAfK3IJuGVg7nUraR7g355ESKlFEcaQrgwtdLf04LG-lvFC7Y-lisXqxRPZNUXno2e5LAIFjrWAoxPrSw6GhfremMIvEzQoVZ)
---
| | Additionally, for the adults in your life, I've written,_The 10: How to Live and Love in a World That Has Lost Its Way_. This book will refresh your understanding and application of the Ten Commandments, showing how living by these principles can improve our personal lives, relationships, churches, and communities.

**I encourage you to point your children or grandchildren towards Jesus Christ.**

For a gift of any amount to support Pathway to Victory, I will send you both books: [https://secure.ptv.org/the-10-commandments-for-kids-generous-gift-1](http://links.liberty-pulse.com/u/click?_t=29bc9815846f49728b1d374165de7bf2&_m=cd7aa592e3e24f54bcbd54a7c18ed084&_e=6RPgqGaUSBI8I6pHkxV__QKzvNe1ScEZZZEgWeI19ddxCpwSZTjatCboR-4iCZRUjG09Z1xDCKqUD3OHc-_bhX3O49vO2r6I9NmD7HOXFO2fbQbUm9Fhk_O36UrF2so_RYWnU7OOs1QdUvhL8BvjUF1UeazvZTlkkO11oTO8XGUX4SoOpTqOEu1CV2ehjCtrc8KDqsCFQ4xtEMjGGs9pTubeX7l96DCj9I1XWztdJQLuv-IDEK4FwSudTjWLq6tcSoRfuwP6dlPoo2ewTymLoKgh3ZfyYKUsUk_QfyrQeILpjsnPJ7ZpElVKgI3Kvp2RKpf9DtexmmWSgEx9_BaqOIwD1uIXd7wY8XMMQertNLqprY-1n-1A0qwbHm22lmWI)

Your generosity enables _Pathway to Victory_ to share bold biblical truths with a broken world. Together, we will make a difference and bring people closer to Christ.

Thank you for standing with us and sharing the gospel of Jesus Christ.

Sharing the Truth of God's Word,

Dr. Robert Jeffress

Let us explain why:
---
We have to be honest, Derek: We’re worried. Let us explain why: Trump and his allies continue to pour millions of dollars into key states across the country. In fact, Republicans are already planning on spending $225 million on ads leading up to Election Day, and this number could absolutely increase. On top of that, we just checked our numbers and we are behind where we need to be to meet our goals leading up to November 5. The goals we have set for these next 19 days are not imaginary. They are very real goals we have to meet to fund and expand our voter outreach work. The work that we do today to turn out and mobilize voters could very well be the difference between victory and defeat on Election Day. That’s why it’s so important we have the resources necessary to continue this work until the very end. Remember, the 2020 election was decided by less than 45,000 votes across a handful of must-win states. This election is shaping up to be just as close. Yet, while McConnell’s money machine is pouring cash into some Senate races, it’s conspicuously ignoring these two key states. Everyone knows why. Ted Cruz and Rick Scott are conservative patriots, not leadership lapdogs. subject: October 17th Update from the Campaign Trail
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY VOTE BOLICK
body:
| | | [ ](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=2b5d909c00&e=a7ab36849c)
---
| | Good afternoon, Freedom Fighters,

In less than three weeks, Arizona will know if the far left was successful in trying to buy a Democrat state legislative majority. Out-of-state special interest groups have been funneling millions of dollars into legislative races across Arizona to turn our state blue, including my very own State Senate race. For the past several months, they have spent money distorting my legislative record to try to gain political power. My opponent has so much money she paid to air attack ads against me on TV stations all over North Phoenix, Cave Creek and Scottsdale. As you know, my legislative district covers only a portion of North Phoenix. I know these ads are being aired outside of my legislative district because I have supporters all over the state and they contact me each time they see an ad against me on cable TV and streaming services.

_The importance of maintaining our state legislature is paramount right now._ The far left has promised to unravel time-honored checks and balances that protect our freedoms. The stakes are super high. My far-left radical opponent isn’t offering an agenda of freedom and opportunity – it is **all** about power and control. In unison, both national and local Democrats are touting a top-down agenda relying on supreme control. These methods have been tried and failed all over the world. We don't want those types of policies in Arizona or Washington, DC. Democrats have not been shy how they want to increase government spending. They have also been touting raising your taxes and adding another layer to current regulatory burdens that will ultimately force small businesses to close. Let's not forget how the Democrat agenda includes unionizing both government and private sector workers. There is a reason why union membership across the country is at an all-time low.

We have our last fundraiser next week. It will be an evening fundraiser on October 22nd from 5:30pm to 7pm to be held in the Moon Valley area of Phoenix with former Congressman John Shadegg and conservative The Patriot radio talk show host Seth Leibsohn. Please RSVP to [info@BolickforArizona.com](mailto:info@BolickforArizona.com?subject=RSVP%20for%20Bolick's%20fundraiser%20on%2010%2F22) for additional information.

This upcoming election could very well flip our state legislature. If that happens, we don’t have to even guess what their left-wing agenda includes. You can read a recent an article published for yourself right [here](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=c665e318f0&e=a7ab36849c) that includes legislation our slim Republican majority has been able to stop the past few legislative sessions.

Our campaign is in the thick of our Get-Out-The-Vote efforts. My top targeted State Senate race is super tight. According to the local paper, legislative district 2’s voter registrations trends towards the Democrats, but our district is considered a “toss-up” race. This bodes well for me. Our message is resonating with voters. Earlier today I spoke with a gentleman who originally came to this country from France at the tail end of the Carter Administration. He told me why he left Europe and how he was in search of the "American Dream." He said as a candidate I do offer him hope and was very supportive of why I was running to maintain this seat in a tight majority. He also told me no other political candidate had ever come to his house to ask for his vote. I always cherish these moments along the campaign trail.

_It should come as no surprise to you that I am on the frontlines to protect you and your family against more government control._ If you support more opportunity and freedom, please consider [investing](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=69746f2355&e=a7ab36849c) in our campaign today. Your support will help us stop the worst leftwing policies from taking place by allowing me to continue to be a check on Hobbs’ radical agenda for the next two years in the State Senate.

Even though I have been wearing a walking boot for nearly a month, I am still engaging with District 2 voters daily. Each day I hear from families who cannot afford the price of higher groceries, and they are especially upset with shrinkflation. One voter even pointed out that the brown paper grocery shopping bags provided by grocers are also getting smaller. I have been sounding the alarm on Biden’s inflationary economy since 2021, but a local news outlet published [this article](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=33a6afada9&e=a7ab36849c) more recently. If you agree with me, you’re not alone. Check out Arizona’s Inflation Misery [Index](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=a182cc1bcc&e=a7ab36849c).

As the November 5th election nears, please keep in mind I have **always** been passionate about educational freedom and will continue to focus on this important issue when I am elected. Also, I have been a staunch defender of parental rights, not government bureaucrats getting in the way of your family’s educational decisions.

This past legislative session I sponsored legislation that was signed into law by Hobbs to [put a stop](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=6846e4d09e&e=a7ab36849c) to some bad actors by banning family reunification camps earlier this year. I had nine bills signed into law this year under a Democrat governor. My far-left radical opponent has yet to have a single piece of legislation signed into law _even under the current democrat governor_. When it comes to critical votes like putting child sex traffickers in prison for natural life, my opponent hid in her office during that vote. She is one of the [most radical members](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=ceae64ab5e&e=a7ab36849c) to serve in the House.

Over the last few days, a lot of voters have been asking me questions about the whereabouts of their November 5th general election ballot. Many voters have yet to receive their early mail-in ballot. They were mailed out in batches of three. If you vote early by mail, you can track your [ballot](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=767c3b1362&e=a7ab36849c). If you want to vote in person in Maricopa County, you can find a polling place [here](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=d659961837&e=a7ab36849c). For truly technical answers, you may want to watch a “behind-the-scenes” account of the life of your early mail-in ballot. You can watch a [video](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=d4be04c226&e=a7ab36849c) produced by Maricopa County. If you are a registered voter in Maricopa County, please go to the voter dashboard at BeBallotReady.Vote to have some of your other questions answered. If you have any additional questions, you can email Maricopa County at [VoterInfo@Risc.Maricopa.Gov](mailto:VoterInfo@Risc.Maricopa.Gov?subject=questions) or call them at 602-506-1511.

With 19 days until the November election, voters have asked if there are potential opportunities to be a poll watcher or poll observer. The answer is yes, and the Arizona Republican party has a sign-up form [here](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=ccc1ff210f&e=a7ab36849c).

In addition to questions I have received about ballots, many voters continue to ask about the length of the ballot from judicial retention elections to propositions. If you reside in Maricopa County, it is two separate pages, front and back.

Earlier this year, I shared the following breakdown of the 2024 Arizona November 5th General Election Ballot Propositions:
| **Proposition** | **Title** | **HOW TO VOTE**
---|---|---
133 | Preserve Our Current Primary Election System | YES, Prop. 133 would require partisan primaries even in local elections, ensuring we don't use ranked choice voting in future elections.
[134](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=7e8e65b4c9&e=a7ab36849c) | Protect Arizona’s Ballot Box | YES, Prop. 134 is fair for all Arizonans by breaking up the Maricopa County monopoly, while also preventing out-of-state influence by requiring citizen initiative petition collectors to gather signatures from voters in all 30 legislative districts.
135 | Limit the Governor’s State of Emergency Powers
| YES, Prop. 135 would protect individual liberties and small businesses during true emergencies.
136 | Ballot Measure Challenges Before Placed on Ballot | YES, Prop. 136 would allow legal challenges to citizen initiatives prior to voter ratification.
137 | Keep Our Judiciary Independent & Our Ballots Shorter | YES, Prop. 137 would continue using Judicial Performance Review (JPR) scores when rating all judges. Future ballots would **only** include the names of judges who don’t meet the JPR performance standard. Out-of-state special interest groups are targeting good judges for removal if that judge produces unfavorable rulings against their policy/political preference. In contrast, the federal judiciary was specifically designed to shield judges from politics.

[138](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=10db43bb12&e=a7ab36849c)
| Tipped Workers Protection Act: protected tipped minimum wage | YES, Prop. 138 is a direct response to out-of-state groups attempting to change the tipping system in Arizona to a service-charge model. With the passage of Prop. 138, it ensures the continuation of the tip credit system and keeps mandatory service charges at bay.

311 | $250K State Benefit 1stResponders | YES, Prop. 311 would create a $250,000 death benefit for first responders killed in the line of duty. Most commercial life insurance policies have exceptions for pay- outs to beneficiaries or require high premiums if the policy holder works under hazardous conditions.
[312](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=e6b615855b&e=a7ab36849c) | Property Tax Nuisance Enforcement: allows property owners to apply for a property tax refund if a municipality doesn’t enforce nuisance laws | YES, Prop. 312 would allow property owners impacted by the failure of local officials to enforce public nuisance laws. This proposition will enable voters to request tax refunds to recoup expenses when ensuring their own safety or remedying the property issues brought on by homeless encampments.
[313](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=866ddfd845&e=a7ab36849c) | Sex Trafficking Natural Life Imprisonment | YES, I sponsored Prop. 313 to be a ballot referral. Prop. 313 would impose mandatory life sentences with no parole for child sex trafficking. Current ARS penalties for child sex trafficking range from seven years to life imprisonment and defendants are eligible for parole after satisfying certain conditions.
[314 ](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=1cd9b2fe34&e=a7ab36849c) | Border Bill- Lawful Ports of Entry/Fentanyl | YES, Prop. 314 does what the federal government should be doing. This proposition will empower state officials to arrest or send back unvetted migrants flooding the border outside of lawful ports of entry. Proposition 314 is a measured response to Biden-Harris’ baffling decision to standdown on border enforcement.

Citizen Initiatives Appearing on the November ballot: **Proposition** | **Summary** | **HOW TO VOTE**
---|---|---
[139](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=68c7d79a04&e=a7ab36849c) | Arizona for Abortion Access | NO, Prop. 139 is vaguely written and doesn't protect women's healthcare. The current law is 15-weeks and was signed into law by Governor Ducey in 2022 and supported by every Republican legislator. Prop. 139 would legalize late term abortion beyond fetal viability. This proposition will allow abortions through all nine months, enable non-family members to arrange abortions for minors, empower unqualified people to evaluate physical and mental conditions, and completely block the state from regulating abortion providers. This proposition is being bankrolled with a $23 million war chest from donors from out-of-state and outside of the US. Women and girls deserve medical care that prioritizes their health and safety.
[140](https://bolickforarizona.us7.list-manage.com/track/click?u=3214fdbd528e32d06cf84fc86&id=c4ea88e5ab&e=a7ab36849c) | Reject California-style Elections | NO, this would create open primaries with California-style elections jungle primaries and Alaska’s Ranked Choice Voting debacle on all Arizona’s elections, causing even more delays in tabulating accurate and fair election votes. This proposition would allow the current radical Secretary of State to unilaterally redesign our election processes. Arizona will spend millions of dollars to institute a system with tabulation algorithms that can’t be explained and results that can’t be audited.

Also, if you want to keep our judiciary independent and free of political bias, consider a YES vote for the judges listed on your ballot for their retention election. Please be sure to vote YES for each judge listed on your ballot. This political season the far left is coming after several exemplary judges and justices for simply doing their job, including my husband who is the only registered Independent who has ever served on the state’s highest court.

body:
Last night only made the stakes even more clear.
#
Did you see that debate? I’ll share my thoughts in a moment – but first, if you’re already with me, [**can you chip in $5 to help me share my closing message with Delaware voters?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20241017-1?refcode=em20241017-1411&amount=5&refcode2=1411_21716_3nVR7D&akid=1411%2E21716%2E3nVR7D)
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20241017-1?refcode=em20241017-1411&refcode2=1411_21716_3nVR7D&akid=1411%2E21716%2E3nVR7D) _Discussing the issues with moderator Ralph Begleiter_
I took the stage last night for the only televised debate of this campaign. Unsurprisingly, my GOP opponent skipped the event – probably because he doesn’t want Delaware voters to know about his support for Project 2025 or hear his litany of right-wing talking points and conspiracy theories.
**Delaware has a choice in this election.** We can continue to build on the progress we’ve made with a Democratic Congress and White House, lift up working people and families, and work together to address important issues like affordable healthcare, housing, and abortion rights.
Or – we can allow Donald Trump and the MAGA GOP to roll back the clock and enact their dangerous agenda, strip away our fundamental freedoms, and return our country to a dark past.
I believe in this nation’s bright future – and in the idea that our best days are still ahead of us. But I also know that it can only happen if people like us commit to doing the work, fighting the good fight, and continuing to make progress for the American people. Our country is counting on us.
Good government should be about making people’s lives better. And that’s why I’m running for Congress – because I have earned a strong track record of achieving progressive results in the Delaware Senate, and I think we need that same spirit and governing philosophy in Washington.
Last night only made the stakes even more clear. It’s essential – for Delaware and our country – that we win this race in November. Thank you for your support,
Sarah McBride

clean_body: Plus: Wildfire smoke and Prop 4 | October 17, 2024 | Restoration Three state parks in the Santa Cruz Mountains—Big Basin Redwoods, Butano, and Año Nuevo—were right in the path of the devastating 2020 CZU Complex fires. How do we bring back these incredible forests for all to enjoy? There’s a new plan for that. Prop 4 Griff Griffith breaks down how Prop 4 could literally clear the air. “It’s like California could finally ditch our smoggy past and move forward into a future that’s fresh and clean.” You did it! Lush videos, interactive timelines, and colorful maps bring a year of epic achievements to life. Take a peek and explore what your steadfast support has made possible. Land protection Home to coast redwoods, flowing creeks, and a rare orchid that smells like honey, this future addition to Montgomery Woods connects more than 4,000 acres of wildlife habitat and buffers the old-growth groves. Community Turning 50 doesn’t mean it’s time to hang up your hiking boots. League-led interpretive hikes through the forest are keeping members of Bay Area Older Adults on their toes. | | ---|--- | | ---|--- 🚨 America’s top state park? Republicans are spending an absolutely bonkers amount of money to try to buy this seat. We cannot let dangerous, self-serving politicians like Donald Trump, JD Vance, and Bernie Moreno take over our government – not with reproductive rights, our planet’s future, and our very democracy on the line. He’s a leader we can trust – but he’s facing his toughest election ever, and thanks to the GOP’s massive spending, he’s down 2 points in the polls. Election Day is coming up fast. We are witnessing a brutal, unceasing, and deadly assault currently being waged against American families--especially the traditional nuclear family. I'm sure you've felt it.

That's why I launched the American Cornerstone Institute--what I call a "think tank / do tank" -- in order to continue this perilous fight to protect, shore up, and support American families. subject: Trump attacked me at a rally. Again.

body:
| Team — During a rambling speech at a campaign rally in Scranton, Pennsylvania, Donald Trump attacked wind power, said he doesn’t care about being nice to women, bragged about getting along well with North Korea’s dictator, Kim Jong Un, and _so much more_ for over 80 minutes.

And he came after me, too, in his unhinged attack.

**[**Before I get into the details of Trump’s attack, I’m hoping you can pitch in a split donation between New Dems and my campaign for Senate — because the last place Donald Trump wants me to be is in the U.S. Senate, where I will hold him and his enablers accountable every single day. »**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95252139/506103448/-1254532222?amount=10&amounts=5,10,25,50,100,250,500&refcode=NDCAF_20241017_EMSPL_E2_T0_AC&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84Mjc1NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjNmE1MmM1OC1kNzhjLWVmMTEtODQ3NC0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=QETzVUtbUi2Tdq6wYLv80H-RpBFfXbGEeFxqSAnwY68=)** **[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95252140/506103449/-1254532222?amount=10&amounts=5,10,25,50,100,250,500&refcode=NDCAF_20241017_EMSPL_E2_T0_AC&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84Mjc1NSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjNmE1MmM1OC1kNzhjLWVmMTEtODQ3NC0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=QETzVUtbUi2Tdq6wYLv80H-RpBFfXbGEeFxqSAnwY68=)**_“You take a child who is 5 years old, he knows more about Russia than my son, and yet**Adam Shifty Schiff** came out of an Intelligence Committee hearing and said ‘Donald Trump Jr. will go to jail for what he did with Russia’... **It was a scam!**... He’s a **sleazebag** that goes out and says my son will go to jail on a con job he made up with Hillary and some of the others. **How bad do you have to be?**... But we’re going to defeat these radical left lunatics.”_ Team, there he goes again. Lie after lie. And the worst part is the former president might actually believe them.

As chair of the House Intelligence Committee, I investigated Donald Trump and revealed he (and Don Jr.) sought Russian help in his election, received it, lied about it, and sought to cover it up. Trump hopes his lies will be a distraction. His insults are meant to take away from the truth — that Donald Trump and his campaign twice sought foreign help to win the presidency.

And when he broke U.S. law by withholding critical aid to Ukraine to extort their leader into helping his campaign, I led his impeachment and secured the first bipartisan Senate vote to convict a U.S. president. He has never let go of that humiliation, so he attacks me. Relentlessly.

He knows that no one has been more effective at holding him accountable for his lies and misdeeds, and nothing infuriates his supporters more than the reminder of how I stood up to him.

Peter,

body:
It’s nearly time, Peter.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20241017-4414-footer&t=1&akid=4414%2E420207%2Edrxmaq)
It’s nearly time, Peter.
This week, ballots are being mailed out in Washington, and people will begin voting in the most consequential election of our lifetimes. Donald Trump has promised to conduct a mass deportation campaign and deploy the military against Americans who don’t support him. We need to take his threats to our democracy seriously.
I’m encouraging everyone to vote _all the way down the ballot_ , including **Kamala Harris** and **Tim Walz** for President and Vice President, **Bob Ferguson** for Governor, **Nick Brown** for Attorney General, **Maria Cantwell** for Senate, and **Dave Upthegrove** for Lands Commissioner.
**I’m also encouraging people to vote “NO” on all four ballot initiatives.** Each of them would repeal a landmark piece of legislation passed by the Democrats in the state legislature and roll back hard-won progress we’ve made on fighting climate change, investing in education, lowering utility costs, and providing health care:
* **Initiative 2117** would allow more pollution across Washington state, threatening our air, waterways and health. And it would slash funding for our state’s transportation plan, putting roads and bridges at risk, cutting transit services and leaving us with more traffic.

* **Initiative 2109** would repeal our state’s capital gains tax on Wall Street profits, giving a tax break to Washington's mega-millionaires and billionaires while slashing $2.2 billion from childcare and public education over the next 5 years.

* **Initiative 2066** would increase energy bills, repeal important customer rebates, and stop communities from making decisions that work best for them.

* **Initiative 2124** would bankrupt Washington’s long term care insurance program, driving up costs for all of us and putting more pressure on women to leave their careers to care for loved ones with disabilities, chronic illness, or who are aging.

Make sure to deposit your ballot in an official drop box by 8 p.m. on Election Day!
Our democracy, our planet, and our fundamental rights are on the ballot. That’s why I’m personally leading door-knocking teams, and our campaign has teamed up with the Harris-Walz campaign to conduct phone banks into swing states across the country. There’s too much at stake to sit on the sidelines.

clean_body: It’s nearly time, Peter. It’s nearly time, Peter. This week, ballots are being mailed out in Washington, and people will begin voting in the most consequential election of our lifetimes. Donald Trump has promised to conduct a mass deportation campaign and deploy the military against Americans who don’t support him. We need to take his threats to our democracy seriously. I’m encouraging everyone to vote all the way down the ballot , including Kamala Harris and Tim Walz for President and Vice President, Bob Ferguson for Governor, Nick Brown for Attorney General, Maria Cantwell for Senate, and Dave Upthegrove for Lands Commissioner. I’m also encouraging people to vote “NO” on all four ballot initiatives. Each of them would repeal a landmark piece of legislation passed by the Democrats in the state legislature and roll back hard-won progress we’ve made on fighting climate change, investing in education, lowering utility costs, and providing health care: Initiative 2117 would allow more pollution across Washington state, threatening our air, waterways and health. And it would slash funding for our state’s transportation plan, putting roads and bridges at risk, cutting transit services and leaving us with more traffic. Initiative 2109 would repeal our state’s capital gains tax on Wall Street profits, giving a tax break to Washington's mega-millionaires and billionaires while slashing $2.2 billion from childcare and public education over the next 5 years. Initiative 2066 would increase energy bills, repeal important customer rebates, and stop communities from making decisions that work best for them. Initiative 2124 would bankrupt Washington’s long term care insurance program, driving up costs for all of us and putting more pressure on women to leave their careers to care for loved ones with disabilities, chronic illness, or who are aging. Make sure to deposit your ballot in an official drop box by 8 p.m. on Election Day! Our democracy, our planet, and our fundamental rights are on the ballot. That’s why I’m personally leading door-knocking teams, and our campaign has teamed up with the Harris-Walz campaign to conduct phone banks into swing states across the country. There’s too much at stake to sit on the sidelines. With ballots dropping tomorrow, we need your support now as much as ever to keep up our critical outreach work ahead of Election Day. Together, Pramila Jayapal | | Email us: info@pramilaforcongress.com

**_I’m not asking for money, just your signature._**

**You may not know me, so let me share my story.**

I owe my life to this country.

My family escaped Vietnam before it fell to the communists when I was four years old, and even though America was unfamiliar at first, in no time, it became my home.

As I grew up, I learned that we owed our lives to the freedoms in this country. That’s why I decided to dedicate my life to serving it.

**My family and I might not be alive if it wasn’t for the greatest nation on Earth, and I had to repay America the best way I could. I attended the U.S. Naval Academy and went on to serve for 25 years, retiring as a Navy Captain in some of the most dangerous corners of the Earth.**

When I was in the Navy, I saw the very best of humanity that America has to offer. _And when I compare it to the_ _“leadership” we see in Washington today, I can’t help but feel we’re missing something._

**It’s no coincidence that as people are losing trust in our elected officials, veteran representation in Congress is at an all-time low.**

_I’m on a mission to change that._

**My name is Hung Cao, and I’m running for the U.S. Senate because America needs veterans in Washington more than ever.**

My family escaped Vietnam before it fell to the communists when I was four years old, and even though America was unfamiliar at first, in no time, it became my home. As I grew up, I learned that we owed our lives to the freedoms in this country. That’s why I decided to dedicate my life to serving it. My family and I might not be alive if it wasn’t for the greatest nation on Earth, and I had to repay America the best way I could. I attended the U.S. Naval Academy and went on to serve for 25 years, retiring as a Navy Captain in some of the most dangerous corners of the Earth. While abortion is legal in Maryland, it's not a guaranteed right. _**In November, we can change that by enshrining the right to reproductive freedom in our state constitution.**_

Voting YES on Question 1 will ensure that every Marylander has reproductive freedom and the power to make their own healthcare decisions, including access to abortion. **But with opposition groups mobilizing, we can’t afford to take this moment for granted.**

| Did you see this? Morning Joe mentioned my campaign for Maryland’s Third Congressional District in a segment on the next generation of women leaders who ran for office after Hillary Clinton’s loss in 2016. I am honored to be included among these incredible leaders who will likely be elected to higher office in November.

At that time, none of my local, state, or federal government representatives were women, so I decided to run for office myself. In 2019, I became the youngest woman elected to the Maryland Senate. This year, hopefully, I will earn election to the U.S. Congress.
---
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/95253457/506107823/1898819010?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTI0OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNTkxZGNhOC1kYjhjLWVmMTEtODQ3NC0wMDBkM2E5OGZhNmIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=uTtIFk7e_z1JjMbee7qurG9xNOq4nGWCCxZJIOuPQwk=&emci=9b6ff926-c78c-ef11-8474-000d3a98fa6b&emdi=1591dca8-db8c-ef11-8474-000d3a98fa6b&ceid=30237190)
From strengthening our public schools and community colleges to protecting the Chesapeake Bay to expanding access to child care to fighting to protect reproductive freedom — as a State Senator, I led on some of the most critical issues and delivered progress for all Marylanders.

We’ve seen just how disastrous and dangerous Donald Trump’s leadership was, especially for women, as he proudly boasts about his role in striking down _Roe v. Wade_ — we came out with fewer rights than we had before. We can’t go back to another four years of MAGA extremism.

Together, we can elect Kamala Harris and Tim Walz at the top of the ticket, send Angela Alsobrooks to the Senate, and elect Board of Education candidates who share our values. clean_body: I am honored to be included among these incredible leaders who will likely be elected to higher office in November. | = | Did you see this? Morning Joe mentioned my campaign for Maryland’s Third Congressional District in a segment on the next generation of women leaders who ran for office after Hillary Clinton’s loss in 2016. I am honored to be included among these incredible leaders who will likely be elected to higher office in November. At that time, none of my local, state, or federal government representatives were women, so I decided to run for office myself. In 2019, I became the youngest woman elected to the Maryland Senate. This year, hopefully, I will earn election to the U.S. Congress. From strengthening our public schools and community colleges to protecting the Chesapeake Bay to expanding access to child care to fighting to protect reproductive freedom — as a State Senator, I led on some of the most critical issues and delivered progress for all Marylanders. We’ve seen just how disastrous and dangerous Donald Trump’s leadership was, especially for women, as he proudly boasts about his role in striking down Roe v. Wade — we came out with fewer rights than we had before. We can’t go back to another four years of MAGA extremism. Together, we can elect Kamala Harris and Tim Walz at the top of the ticket, send Angela Alsobrooks to the Senate, and elect Board of Education candidates who share our values. I’m ready to get to work on day one and continue to fight for progress in Congress. But I need your help to ensure our volunteers have the resources to knock on more doors, distribute yard signs, and talk to voters about what matters most in this final stretch. = | = | = | = | = | = Thank you for all you do, Sarah Elfreth * | | = Paid for by Elfreth for Maryland Elfreth for Maryland PO Box 5935 Annapolis, MD 21403 United States

* * *
Last week, Lauren Boebert headlined a Trump rally with this guy: [](http://links.defeatboebertpac.com/u/click?_t=c3d87ac674644038b5146447a156028d&_m=6ab06e3194ac4bb78ecadfab7b8655ea&_e=vIWprA--BF3zJOzO0UMVLks-iB0OKQ9WJXRFoMunRLubUF1GyLnrGyGA86vjHPo0Hn-WY-kVk7v6kK9AsPdHFQB5syzGXipxGhrEcuCaWMj8qFuH-p5QVK-_fzwrkUF7yONCsDRY6lejYe-1R01DRNWevRRVT3mGKK3UHszJzhPTeZouw1x-g-P1jcCdhOKELRoMs2DsSTN7Qg_4UGaSyerNGHLuQrjAkvBNTaAQN7RjGWlbM6Ho0RcOVpzvjeYUk-Xgc29nmivL8H50vdpN8gAMGI8GOMeMWPqKm6pk0buWr-jnG5bjzuVTEpAzDyjqyLu8MygSvrGDAHiYQt8KtgxseUms7ZBk9h2eYlGRozqJrZTi2NlGd1dz39v5mZa6qi1uXXWFZg6mf1vinqY9TDo_hQEa_xabApoqQ8ARJJBnVbKWujmkp0MMlWo2ezNW) That’s Stephen Miller.
